lens: robust-bayesian (the skeptic: every estimate shrunk toward its prior, every conditional rule priced against its base rate of being noise, overfitting and broker-rule uncertainty integrated over rather than assumed away; the plan is the one that is hardest to be wrong about, and each rule states what evidence would move it)
thesis: The book is small relative to any honest Kelly (quarter-Kelly under the PESSIMISTIC keep-0.30 branch is m 1.25 = GRM 1.875; under the central keep 0.60 it is m 2.6), growth is monotone in size up to the broker wall under every haircut in the prior, and the only things that bind are (a) portfolio margin on 5-10 historical cluster days, whose rate is itself uncertain (TIMS 15/8/45 puts the wall at m 1.63-1.80, the rules-based 90% short-3x reading puts it at m 1.01 on 2023-02-03), and (b) the 27-71% haircut range on the ledger mean. So: step GRM 1.5 -> 1.875 behind a margin-feasibility guard and an IBKR what-if check, keep the flat $750k base, move relative risk toward TRUSTED edge (keep-adjusted Sigma^-1 mu, clip 0.7-1.3), ship only the conditional rules whose two-groups posterior multiplier survives at 0.68-1.43 (OVS extremity cut at 0.7x not 0.5x, family flow up-size 1.2x and a flow-aware cap, OLV ladder re-keyed to depth-or-ticker, WCDS/LT solo-adds 0.8/1.2), paper-track the dial-armed hedge whose posterior is +$3.5k per episode, and refuse every calendar, VIX, P/C, drawdown-state, correlation and book-scalar rule because each posterior sits within 0.03 of 1.0 or the evidence pack records it dead.

grm.value: 1.875 (m = 1.25x current) as the next step, shipped only after GM-2 (margin guard) is live and an IBKR what-if margin call on the 2023-02-03, 2016-06-14 and 2019-06-26 books at 1.25x passes; 2.25 (m 1.5) is the SECOND step, allowed only after the live-vs-ledger keep is measured on >= 150 broker-matched fills at >= 0.5 AND either the index legs of the dip-buy cluster are routed to ES/MES or the guard has fired cleanly through one cluster day. Hold 1.5 if the IBKR what-if shows rules-based (90%) margin on short 3x ETFs and no guard exists, because the book is already at the wall on that day type (requirement 99% of $750k at m = 1, 117% of the $632k live NLV).
grm.rationale: Math (scratch/ultracode_sizing_2026-09-02/robust_bayes_01_grm.json). (1) Growth: g(m) = 252 E[log(1 + m (r - (1-k) mu))] with keep k ~ Beta(6.63, 4.80) (mean 0.58, 5-95% 0.34-0.79, the estimation-haircut study's 0.29-0.73 range). Prior-mean g: 2003+ m=1 12.5%, m=1.25 15.4%, m=1.5 18.3%, m=2 23.7%; 2016+ 18.7 / 23.2 / 27.5 / 35.9%. Pessimistic keep 0.30: 2003+ 6.1 / 7.4 / 8.7 / 10.9%; 2016+ 9.3 / 11.3 / 13.3 / 17.0%. The argmax is m = 6 (the top of the grid) under EVERY keep and both windows: curvature never argues against a step in the feasible range; only the boundaries do. (2) Fractional-Kelly reading: at keep 0.60 the book's Sharpe is 1.18 (2003+) / 1.60 (2016+) on 11.5% / 12.5% vol, so full-Kelly leverage L* = S/sigma = 10.3x / 12.8x current and m 1.25 is 12% / 10% of honest Kelly; at keep 0.30 (Sharpe 0.59 / 0.80) L* = 5.1x / 6.4x and m 1.25 is 24% / 20%, i.e. m 1.25 is the largest multiple that stays at or under quarter-Kelly on the pessimistic branch of the prior (Thorp / Benter / Ziemba floor). m 1.5 would be 29% / 23% there. (3) Margin (robust_bayes_01_grm.json C, robust_bayes_01b_margin_sens.json): requirement/NAV on the max day with TIMS rates (stock 15, broad ETF 8, small-cap 10, 3x 45): 0.61 (2013-11-04) 2003+, 0.55 (2023-02-03) 2016+ -> feasible m 1.63 / 1.80 on $750k, 1.37 / 1.52 on the $632k live NLV; p99 day m 2.9 / 2.4 live. With broad ETFs charged 15% as the pack's margin study did: m 1.51 / 1.64 (reproduces its 1.60). Under the pessimistic reading (rules-based 90% on short 3x, 75% long 3x, per-share minimums on sub-$17 shorts): max day 2023-02-03 requires 0.99-1.00 of $750k at m = 1 (3x ETF Overbot Fade 0.97 NAV gross + OVS 0.75), m_max 1.01 on $750k and 0.85 on live NLV, 21 days over 50% of NAV in 23 years. That single unresolved broker fact is worth more than any drawdown table, which is why GM-2 and the what-if are preconditions rather than nice-to-haves. (4) The live primary NLV (~$632k, 2026-08-18 note) is below the $750k constant, so the account already runs 1.19x the risk a NAV basis would give: GRM 1.875 on the flat base is 2.22x in live-NAV terms. (5) Liquidity does not bind (edge halves at m ~58; overflow ATR Ext at m ~12), and the per-strategy 250 bps cap costs ~1 pt of growth at m 1.25-1.5 (cap-fixed g 47.4% vs 48.4% linear at m 1.5, 2016+).
grm.drawdown_accepted: Block bootstrap (mean block 10, 2000 x 1y and 1500 x 3y paths, compounded % of peak) at GRM 1.875, robust_bayes_01_grm.json B. Central keep 0.60: 1y median maxDD 8.1% (2016+) to 8.9% (2003+), p95 14.2-16.6%, P(1y > 15%) 4.0-8.8%, P(1y > 20%) 0.4-1.3%; 3y median 11.1-12.8%, p95 17.9-21.7%, P(3y > 20%) 1.9-8.1%, P(3y > 30%) 0.0-0.7%. Pessimistic keep 0.30: 1y median 10.4-10.5%, p95 19.4-20.0%, P(1y > 15%) 16.7-20.2%, P(1y > 20%) 4.4-5.0%; 3y median 15.7-16.2%, p95 26.8-28.5%, P(3y > 20%) 22.7-27.4%, P(3y > 30%) 2.6-3.8%. Keep 0.45: 1y P(> 15%) 8.4-13.6%, 3y P(> 20%) 7.1-15.7%. The actual 2003-2026 path scaled 1.25x: maxDD ~15% of $750k (12% x 1.25), worst day -6.1% (-4.89% x 1.25; the pack's -8.8% figure is the 2003+ path at m 1.5 including the OVS-heavy 2008 era). Add roughly one point of vol and half a point of maxDD for the AL-1 tilt and the flow package (their walk-forwards show maxDD flat to better, so this is a cushion). For the second step (GRM 2.25) the same tables read: keep 0.60 1y P(> 15%) 9.8-20.6%, P(> 20%) 2.0-4.4%, 3y P(> 20%) 7.1-19.4%; keep 0.30 1y P(> 15%) 30-33%, 3y P(> 20%) 43-45%. All of these are accepted; none of them is the constraint. The constraint is a forced liquidation at 15:45 ET on a cluster day, which the drawdown tables cannot see and the guard is for.

changes.name: GLOBAL_RISK_MULTIPLIER 1.5 -> 1.875, gated; 2.25 as a second, evidence-gated step
changes.rule: Set GLOBAL_RISK_MULTIPLIER = 1.875 once (a) GM-2 is live in order_staging, (b) an IBKR what-if margin query on the three historical tail-day books (2023-02-03 3x-fade + OVS cluster; 2016-06-14 and 2019-06-26 dip-buy clusters) scaled 1.25x returns a requirement under 70% of live NLV, and (c) M-1's headroom monitor is on the site. Re-derive the step whenever live NLV moves 20% or the what-if is re-run. GRM 2.25 only when the measured live keep (M-1) on >= 150 broker-matched fills is >= 0.50 and either the SPY/QQQ/DIA legs of WCDS / Monday Dip / MonFri / IOB / Monthly Weak Close route to ES/MES or the guard has trimmed cleanly through one real cluster day. Per-strategy 250 bps cap stays FIXED through both steps.
changes.expected_effect: +2.9 pts (2003+) / +4.4 pts (2016+) of annual log growth at the prior mean, +1.3 / +2.1 pts at keep 0.30; on the flat ledger basis +25% of ~$157k/yr = +$39k/yr, of which ~$24k/yr is expected live at keep 0.60. Book vol 11.5% -> 14.3% (2003+) or 12.5% -> 15.7% (2016+). Drawdown accepted per the grm block: 1y P(maxDD > 15%) 4-9% at keep 0.60, 17-20% at keep 0.30. Cap cost ~1 pt of growth. Liquidity drag 2.8% -> ~4.2% of NAV/yr at k=1 sqrt impact.
changes.confidence: moderate on the step (growth math is unambiguous under every haircut; three windows, four tail models, two haircuts all put m* >= 6); LOW on the timing until the IBKR what-if resolves the 3x margin rate, which moves the wall between m 1.0 and m 1.8
changes.evidence: robust_bayes_01_grm.json A-C; robust_bayes_01b_margin_sens.json; unconstrained_growth_results.json (m* 15.5-19.25 raw, 9-11.75 at 50% haircut, 6.25-9 GPD; margin m 1.60 max day at broad 15%; liquidity edge halves at m 58); estimation_haircut_results.json (keep 0.60, range 0.29-0.73); Kelly base rates (Thorp 2006 g(c)/g_max = c(2-c), practitioner 1/4-1/2 Kelly of honest edge; Carver half-Sharpe-then-half-Kelly = ~25% of backtest Kelly); Suhonen 2017 / McLean-Pontiff 2016 / Harvey-Liu 2015 decay base rates 26-73%
changes.risks: The wall is set by 5-10 cluster days that are also the book's best days (gross > 100% NAV days = 15% of days, 49% of PnL); a guard that trims them costs unmeasured PnL. IBKR house margin can rise 35% overnight (Sept-Oct 2020 precedent) and single names can go to 100-300% (Jan 2021); Soft Edge Margin expires at 15:45 ET and IBKR liquidates without a call. Block bootstrap under-samples multi-month regimes; the 2003+ window's 2008 was a short-heavy OVS book. Effective live risk is already 1.19x the NAV basis.
changes.intuition: Growth is linear this far down the curve, so the question is never whether more size pays, it is what breaks first. What breaks first is the broker, on a day the book is long four index ETFs at 4x gross or short a 3x-ETF cluster at 1x gross, and that is a step function the bootstrap cannot see. Step, verify, step.
changes.base_rate_support: Practitioners run 25-50% of HONEST Kelly (Thorp, Benter, Ziemba); at keep 0.30 this book at m 1.25 is 20-24% of Kelly, at keep 0.60 it is 10-12%. Live-vs-backtest decay medians of 26-73% (McLean-Pontiff, Falck-Rej-Thesmar 43%, Suhonen 73%) bracket the 40% central haircut used here. Thorp's 1987 warning (2x leverage -> 2.85x before rebalance) is the jump-risk reason the margin wall, not the drawdown table, sets the step.
changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config.GLOBAL_RISK_MULTIPLIER is the single source (all nominal bps scale at import). Order: M-1 what-if and monitor -> GM-2 guard -> GRM 1.875 -> one month of monitor readings -> revisit. Commit message carries the what-if numbers. Do NOT scale the 250 bps cap with GRM (it binds on 2% of strategy-signal-days at m 1.25 and bounds the worst day: -$44k vs -$118k uncapped). PA (~$66k, below the PM minimum) keeps its own clamp and is not part of this step.

changes.name: Margin-feasibility guard in order_staging (broker constraint, not an ATR cap)
changes.rule: Before submission, project the day's requirement = sum over open positions and today's staged entries of notional x class rate (stock 15%, broad index ETF 8%, small-cap index 10%, 3x ETF 45% long / use the rate the IBKR what-if reports for short 3x, sub-$16.67 short stock max(15%, $5/share), sub-$5 100%) on LIVE NLV. If projected requirement > 70% of NLV, scale today's NEW entries pro rata to land at 70% (existing positions untouched; never cancel an entry below 1 share, drop it). Log every trim with the projected ratio. Rates are replaced by IBKR's what-if numbers as soon as M-1 delivers them.
changes.math: Requirement/NAV at m = 1: TIMS p95 0.22-0.23, p99 0.35, max 0.55-0.61 (6 days over 50% in 23 years); rules-based 3x: p99 0.39-0.42, max 0.99 (21 days over 50%, 4 over 70%). At m 1.25 the 2023-02-03 book reads 0.69 (TIMS) or 1.24 (rules-based); the 2016-06-14 book 0.69 (broad 8%) or 0.76 (broad 15%). A 70% trigger binds on roughly 0-4 days per decade at m 1.25 under TIMS and ~10-20 under the rules-based reading.
changes.expected_effect: Converts the forced-liquidation tail (joint bootstrap P(requirement > equity within 3y) 0.1-0.4% at m 1.5 plain PM, 7-10% with a 15% cushion, 55-73% with a concentration add-on) into a planned same-day haircut. PnL cost unmeasured; upper bound is the PnL of the trimmed entries on the handful of days it fires (those days average 44 bps/day vs 8 bps book-wide, so assume -$5k to -$15k per firing day at 1.25x).
changes.confidence: high that it is needed before any GRM step; low on its cost until replayed
changes.evidence: robust_bayes_01b_margin_sens.json (rules-based max day 0.99 NAV at m=1, 2023-02-03, 3x ETF Overbot Fade 0.97 NAV + OVS 0.75); robust_bayes_01_grm.json C; unconstrained_growth_results.json margin block (joint bootstrap ruin probabilities); IBKR TIMS +/-15% stock, +6/-8% broad index, 3x multiplier, Soft Edge Margin 15:45 ET, no-call auto-liquidation; the no-notional-caps memory note (this guard is denominated in broker requirement, not notional, and fires only on projected infeasibility)
changes.risks: It trims the book's best days. It needs the true IBKR rates or it either over-trims (rules-based assumed, TIMS applies) or under-protects (the reverse). The T+3 OLV fill window and OVS T+1 gating mean staged risk is not filled risk; project on staged. Two accounts, two NLVs.
changes.intuition: The book already peaked at ~84% of NAV in one strategy with the dial at 89.5; the retired OLV book cap was directionally right about the aggregate and wrong about the denominator. Denominate the ceiling in what the broker actually charges and it stops being an appetite argument.
changes.base_rate_support: IBKR liquidates automatically with no cure period; house margin rose up to 35% in Oct 2020; GME/AMC shorts went to 300% overnight in Jan 2021. Pod shops run 4-8x gross per fundamental pod but under platform-level stress tests, which is the guard's role here.
changes.implementation_notes: order_staging.py (OneDrive trading_ibkr) new stage after the per-strategy cap and before submission; reads /exec-book for open positions and betas.json-style class map; the class map lives beside futures_specs.json. Replay the rule on the ledger (scale staged rows by the guard's factor on the days it fires) before ship so the cost is a number. Guard test: test_margin_guard.py (OneDrive) with the three historical books as fixtures. The event sleeve MOC and OLV OPG exits do not go through it (exits reduce requirement).

changes.name: Sizing base: flat $750k until NLV exceeds it, then half-compounding
changes.rule: ACCOUNT_VALUE stays 750,000 while live primary NLV < 750,000. When NLV > 750,000 at a quarter end: base = max(prior base, 0.5 x 750,000 + 0.5 x NLV), reset quarterly, never rebased down. Full compounding only if the measured live keep (M-1) is >= 0.75.
changes.math: 10y block bootstrap medians (2016+, m=1, no haircut): flat 4.3x, half-compounding 9.0x, full 25.6x; %-of-peak maxDD identical (9%); max dollar DD in units of initial capital p95: flat 13%, full 274%. At 50% haircut, m 1.5: 3.5x / 5.6x / 10.2x. 3y P(comp < flat on the same path) 9-24% in the haircut cells, ~0% over 10y. Switching to live NAV today = 632/750 = 0.84x risk, a 16% cut; effective GRM in live terms is already 1.78.
changes.expected_effect: No change now. Once NLV > $750k, roughly doubles the 10-year median terminal multiple versus flat (9.0x vs 4.3x) at the same percentage drawdowns, with dollar drawdowns growing at half the rate of full compounding.
changes.confidence: moderate
changes.evidence: unconstrained_growth_results.json compounding_policies block; the pack's finding 6 on compounding; live NLV note 2026-08-18
changes.risks: Compounding assumes the edge scales with size (bounded by GM-2 and liquidity); a base that never rebases down means a drawdown leaves risk elevated relative to NAV, which is the flat basis's known property and the reason the guard is denominated on live NLV.
changes.intuition: Flat sizing is a hidden de-leveraging rule that pays in exactly the bad first-year paths; keep it until the account has outgrown the constant.
changes.base_rate_support: Kelly/GBM: growth share c(2-c) is indifferent to the base at small c; the sequencing-regret asymmetry (compounding hurts most after an early drawdown) is the standard argument for partial compounding.
changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config.ACCOUNT_VALUE; quarterly re-set is a one-line change with the NLV in the commit message; the guard (GM-2) uses live NLV regardless of the base.

changes.name: Haircut on the ledger mean: 40% central (keep 0.60), range 27-71%, per-strategy keep_s as the mu shrinkage
changes.rule: Every sizing number that is sized to a mean uses keep_book = 0.60 (range 0.29-0.73) until M-1 measures it. Per strategy: keep_s = selection x realized-2026 x survivorship x cost from estimation_haircut_results.json with two judgement overrides (OVS 0.48, 52wh 0.42; the mechanical 0.30/0.31 are version-count artefacts): 3x ETF Fade 0.78, 3x Bear 0.74, ATR Ext 0.73, MonFri 0.72, Monday Dip 0.69, IOB 0.68, Sector BO 0.65, St OS 0.50, OVS 0.48, OLV 0.45, 3x Leader 0.44, Monthly WC 0.44, 52wh 0.42, LT Trend 0.41, WCDS 0.37. Pilots with N < 30 capped at keep 0.50 regardless of their own numbers. Re-derive after 150 matched fills and after 2027 Q1 (first non-midterm OOS quarters).
changes.math: Book: bottom-up PnL-weighted keep 0.51 [0.29, 0.73]; direct (DSR keep 0.72 at N=250 trials x cost 0.92 x survivorship 0.95 = 0.63, blended with the midterm-conditioned 2026 realization 0.76) 0.70; recommended mean 0.605. DSR noise ceiling for 23y daily data: E[max SR] 0.53 (N=100) to 0.68 (N=1000) trials, so selection alone cannot manufacture a Sharpe of 2; the rest of the haircut is structural (crowding, regime, costs 5.6%, survivorship ~15% on overflow longs). 2026 realized 0.52x per unit risk (risk-weighted), 1.22x the midterm base rate.
changes.expected_effect: No direct PnL effect; it sets GM-1's frontier and AL-1's tilt. Replacing the plan's flat 50% with 40% moves GM-1's 1y P(DD > 15%) at GRM 1.875 from 9.1% (plan's 50% row) to 4-9% (keep 0.60 rows).
changes.confidence: moderate (both estimators bracket 0.60; neither is independent of the 2026 year)
changes.evidence: estimation_haircut_results.json; the pack's estimation_haircut findings 1-8; outside base rates McLean-Pontiff 26%/58%, Falck-Rej-Thesmar 43%, Ilmanen et al 30%, Suhonen 73%, Chen-Velikov post-cost ~93% for generic anomalies, Bailey-LdP DSR
changes.risks: The post-freeze OOS window (108 trades) has a CI of [-0.57, 1.22] on the ratio; 2026 is one partial midterm year; survivorship magnitudes are scenario-based (no delisted-name history in the cache).
changes.intuition: The book's mitigants (23 years, 4,700 trades, pre-registration, a live track) argue for the mild end of the published decay; its 259 config versions and 2026 argue for the harsh end. 0.60 is the midpoint and both bounds are defended by an estimator.
changes.base_rate_support: Harvey-Liu: a flat 50% haircut is a serious mistake, haircut by t-stat instead (t > 3 small, t ~ 2 large); Jensen-Kelly-Pedersen: RANK survives out of sample even when levels shrink, which is what lets AL-1 lean on backtest ordering.
changes.implementation_notes: Keep vector lives in scratch/ultracode_sizing_2026-09-02/estimation_haircut_results.json today; when adopted it belongs in a committed data/sizing_keep.json read by the annual AL-1 refit script, with the date and N of matched fills that produced it.

changes.name: Keep-adjusted capped half-tilt on base bps, clip [0.7, 1.3], annual refit
changes.rule: Multiplier per strategy = clip(0.5 w + 0.5, 0.7, 1.3), w = normalised Sigma_tilde^-1 mu_tilde on the per-strategy flat-basis daily series 2006 to the prior December, Sigma_tilde Ledoit-Wolf-shrunk (delta 0.3), mu_tilde = 0.5 x (keep_s x mu_s) + 0.5 x equal-Sharpe prior on keep-adjusted means. From the fit through 2025: 52wh 0.70, Weak Close 0.75, Sector BO 0.87, St OS Sznl 0.88, IOB 0.89, OVS 0.96 -> held at 1.0 (cap-bound, not bps-bound), LT Trend 1.04, Monday Dip 1.09, ATR Ext 1.10, OLV 1.17, 3x ETF Fade 1.27, MonFri 1.30; 3x Bear Fade, 3x Leader Gap Fade, Monthly Weak Close 1.0 (too few active days). Composes with every existing overlay. Engine confirmation gate before go-live (plan P3): process_signals_fast(risk_multipliers=...) must reproduce >= half the walk-forward gain with maxDD no worse by > 1 pt.
changes.math: Walk-forward 2014-2026, fit before Jan 1 of Y, in-sample vol-matched to equal weights: equal ann 24.2% NAV, vol 11.8, Sharpe 2.048, maxDD -12.1, PnL/maxDD 1.99; keep-adjusted clip 0.7-1.3: ann 27.4, vol 12.8, Sharpe 2.144, maxDD -11.4, PnL/maxDD 2.40 (+20%), 11 of 13 years better, worst held-out year -4.0% vs equal, 13y gain +42 pts NAV; plan's own tilt (clip 0.6-1.4, no keep): 27.8 / 13.1 / 2.132 / -12.1 / 2.29 (+15%), 11/13, worst year -12.6%. Trust-only (keep ratio, no covariance): -1 pt, 9/13 (rank information needs the covariance solve).
changes.expected_effect: +3.2 pts of NAV per year over equal weights at +1.0 pt vol, maxDD 0.7 pt BETTER, PnL/maxDD +20%; worst held-out year -4% (the plan's version: -12.6%). Cuts land on 52wh, WCDS, Sector BO, St OS, IOB (61% of worst-5%-day losses for 36% of PnL); raises on MonFri, 3x ETF Fade, OLV, ATR Ext, Monday Dip.
changes.confidence: moderate: the walk-forward is out of sample for the weights but keep_s is estimated on the full sample including 2026 (lookahead in the keep vector); the ranking is unanimous across three estimators (plan daily route, per-trade route, keep-adjusted) on the four to cut and the three to raise
changes.evidence: robust_bayes_03_allocation.json (per_year, summary, gate, shipping); dynamic_sizing_results3/4 (plan's L1 walk-forward, tail ownership, era stability); estimation_haircut_results.json trust tiers
changes.risks: OLV 1.17 and LT Trend 1.04 raise the two strategies whose 2026 is least explained by cycle or dial (OLV P(2026 < half trailing) 0.96); the pack's 2027 Q1 re-read trigger applies. Overflow survivorship flatters OLV/LT/St OS; the keep factors already carry 0.85 for that. Raised strategies hit the 250 bps cap more often; the engine replay is the confirmation. A strategy below 0.7 for two consecutive refits is a retirement question.
changes.intuition: Allocate on what you trust, not on what the ledger printed. The plan's ranking survives the keep adjustment; what changes is the amplitude and, above all, the worst held-out year.
changes.base_rate_support: Kelly multi-asset f = Sigma^-1 mu; Chopra-Ziemba: errors in means cost ~10x errors in variances, so shrink mu hardest; Jensen-Kelly-Pedersen: in-sample rank carries into OOS; Busseti-Ryu-Boyd: heterogeneous Kelly fractions beat one scalar at equal drawdown risk; Baker-McHale shrinkage grows with the uncertainty of the edge estimate.
changes.implementation_notes: Per-strategy execution['risk_mult'] (or the risk_multipliers hook) in strategy_config, refit each January by a script that reads the daily payload and data/sizing_keep.json and prints the table into the commit; daily_scan and strat_backtester read it as a base-bps scaler ahead of 2b. OVS held at 1.0. Clip is 0.7-1.3 so no January moves a strategy more than 30%.

changes.name: OLV ladder re-keyed to max(ticker-recency rung, sleeve-depth rung)
changes.rule: mult = max(recency_rung(ticker, 21 td: 0 prior -> 0.5, 1 -> 0.7, 2+ -> 1.0), depth_rung(n open OLV legs incl. WORKING entries: 0 -> 0.5, 1-2 -> 0.7, 3+ -> 1.0)). Same-ticker adds full size; 50%-NAV ticker cap unchanged; composes with the earnings override and (bandless) frag state as today. The 0.5x solo rung stays McKinley's appetite cut; the re-key only stops it landing on the strong cells.
changes.math: Solo OLV legs avgR 0.48 (N 86); adds 0.73 at 1 open, 0.93 at 3-5, 1.13 at 6-12, 1.18 at 13+; adds vs solo +0.39R, episode-bootstrap P(<= 0) 0.017; two-groups posterior (pi1 0.35 geometric, tau 0.25): P(real) 0.55, E[delta] +0.14R -> solo 0.91x / adds 1.09x, i.e. the evidence supports a mild grade, the 0.5x is appetite. Current ladder halves 81% of solo legs but also 43-49% of legs entered into 3+ open names. Replay 2005-2026: current $418k PnL / $529k risk / 0.790 PnL per $ risk / exit-basis worst-21d -14.0k / MTM maxDD -40.6k; max(recency, depth) $543k / $662k / 0.820 / -13.4k / -54.1k (-43.3k at equal risk), PnL/risk >= current in 15 of 20 years.
changes.expected_effect: +$125k over 21 years raw (+$6k/yr), +$16k at equal risk, PnL per $ risk 0.790 -> 0.820, exit-basis worst-21d and maxDD both better; footprint +25%, so MTM maxDD widens raw (-40.6k -> -54.1k) and is -43.3k at equal risk.
changes.confidence: moderate (cell structure t 1.6-2.0, LOYO floors 1.0-1.5, bootstrap P 0.007-0.017; direction agrees with the ladder's own 2026-07-30 rationale)
changes.evidence: within_strategy_adds_results.json f1/f4; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json OLV-DEPTH / OLV-SOLO; CLAUDE.md Ladder Sizing history (the open-count form was retired for operational reasons, not evidence)
changes.risks: Depth counted on filled legs in the study; live must count working T+3 limits or the first two days of a stack are invisible. OLV's 2026 underperformance (0.36x trailing) is the strategy's own watch item. OLV stacks are one bet (implied rho 0.73-0.99); the hedge (XS-1) and the ticker cap carry that, not this rule.
changes.intuition: The isolated first signal in a name is the weak cell whether or not other OLV names are open; a third leg into a sector washout is the strong cell whether or not this ticker fired before. Key the cut on both and take the max.
changes.base_rate_support: Within-strategy Kelly says size by conditional expectancy; Nagel: liquidity-provision returns are largest in clustered selloffs, which is what a deep OLV stack is.
changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config OLV execution: signal_recency_ladder unchanged plus a depth_ladder {rungs: [0.5, 0.7, 1.0], counts: [0, 1, 3], include_working: True}; daily_scan step 2c takes max of the two (open legs from load_open_position_counts + working entries from the staging tabs); strat_backtester's candidate pre-pass counts open filled + candidates inside the fill window; guard tests/test_olv_stop_and_cap.py extended.

changes.name: WCDS and LT Trend ST OS: solo 0.8x / adds 1.2x
changes.rule: For Weak Close Decent Sznls and LT Trend ST OS: mult = 0.8 if no leg of that strategy is open or working, else 1.2 (adds = any leg entered with >= 1 of the strategy's legs open; same-sector clusters explicitly NOT cut). Composes with frag / P/C bands, the L1 tilt and the 250 bps cap.
changes.math: WCDS adds 0.73R same-day (N 75, t 2.7, LOYO 2.1) vs solo 0.21 (156); LT depth >= 3 0.63R (25, t 2.65, LOYO 2.0, P 0.009) vs solo 0.22 (134). Posterior (pi1 0.35, tau 0.25): WCDS adds P(real) 0.66, mult 1.24; LT adds 0.67, 1.29. Study replay at 0.75/1.25: WCDS $337k -> $362k on 5% LESS risk, PnL/risk 0.281 -> 0.317, +$43k at equal risk, MTM maxDD -60.8k -> -55.1k, cap binds on 9 of 194 signal days; LT $233k -> $242k on 4% less risk, PnL/risk 0.301 -> 0.327, +$20k equal risk, worst-21d -15.5k -> -12.5k. At 0.8/1.2 expect ~80% of those dollar figures.
changes.expected_effect: WCDS about +$35k, LT about +$16k at equal risk over 21 years, with sleeve maxDD and worst-21d better in both; roughly +$2.5k/yr combined.
changes.confidence: moderate (18/22 and 8/10 years; both lenses, edge and Euler variance, agree for these two)
changes.evidence: within_strategy_adds_results.json f6, package; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json WCDS-ADDS / LTT-ADDS
changes.risks: WCDS Size_Mult carries a legacy seasonal tilt the replay left in place; LT dial cells are small and on the recompute vintage. At dial 65+ LT's solo legs are -0.12R and its adds +0.63R, so this rule and XS-2 overlap; ship this first, it does not depend on the dial.
changes.intuition: A second weak close in a sector on the same day is the washout; a lone one is noise.
changes.base_rate_support: Same Kelly-by-conditional-expectancy logic; Ang-Chen downside-correlation asymmetry is largest in past losers, which is why the cluster is one bet AND the better bet.
changes.implementation_notes: Generic execution['depth_mults'] = {0: 0.8, 1: 1.2} read by daily_scan (open + working counts per strategy) and strat_backtester (filled + in-window candidates); tests: extend tests/test_same_day_derate.py's pattern for a two-rung open-count table.

changes.name: OVS bottom-extremity cut at 0.7x (not 0.5x)
changes.rule: OVS signal whose mean of rank_ret_2d/5d/10d/21d < 94 -> risk mult 0.7; else 1.0. No top-tier boost. Composes with path, cycle mult, scale-out, P2 cap and the per-strategy cap. Replayed point-in-time in strat_backtester from the same rank columns.
changes.math: Bottom cell avgR 0.17 (N 392, win 0.59) vs 0.47 (878); episode-clustered t 5.4 on the z-feature, ~3.3 on the binary cut (se ~0.09); LOYO 80%, holds in both tiers, both paths, all four eras; walk-forward tercile version +19.7% PnL, 13/18 years. Two-groups posterior: provenance pi1 0.10 (594-test scan) x empirical-Bayes 0.89 (14 full-rule passes vs 1.5 expected) -> geometric 0.30; P(real) 0.95, E[delta] -0.25R, half-Kelly mult = 1 + 0.5 x (-0.25 / 0.39) = 0.68. The study's 0.5x is the fitted in-sample value; 0.7x is what survives shrinkage.
changes.expected_effect: On equal total OVS risk the 0.5x form gives R per unit risk 0.298 -> 0.337 (+12.9%), 17/24 years better, daily sd x1.06, worst year -$13.9k (2020); 0.7x gives roughly two thirds: ~+8% R/risk. If the freed risk is NOT redeployed: about -$22k over 24 years (0.5x: -$36k) against $607k OVS PnL, with the OVS staged-risk footprint down ~20%.
changes.confidence: moderate-high on the cell (the strongest within-strategy quality gradient in the book); moderate on the multiplier (0.68 at tau 0.25, 0.65-0.74 across tau)
changes.evidence: signal_quality_results.json f1 / R1; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json SQ-OVS-EXT; the deleted-ML lesson (win rate and expectancy move TOGETHER here: +0.12 win, +0.30R, so it is not the P(win) trap)
changes.risks: Cut-point 94 chosen after seeing terciles (walk-forward tercile form is the clean check); midterm years flatten the gradient (bottom 0.10 vs 0.17); does not model cap interactions (a smaller bottom cell frees cap room on cluster days, which helps). Engine replay with caps before ship.
changes.intuition: The reversal scales with the prior move; a spike that barely clears the rank threshold is the one that keeps going.
changes.base_rate_support: Nagel: reversal returns scale with the size of the dislocation; Dai-Medhat-Novy-Marx-Rizova: higher-vol names reverse faster and initially stronger.
changes.implementation_notes: OVS execution['extremity_cut'] = {rank_cols: [2,5,10,21], threshold: 94, mult: 0.7}; daily_scan reads the rank columns it already computes for the filter; strat_backtester sizing step 3b; stamp the mult into Sizing notes; guard test on the boundary at 94.0.

changes.name: Clone clamps: IOB SPY+QQQ same-day 0.5x each; dip-buy cross-strategy same-ticker clamp extended (from the baseline plan)
changes.rule: Indices Oversold Bounce SPY and QQQ firing the same day -> each at 0.5x. CROSS_STRATEGY_OVERLAP_OVERRIDES extended to every dip-buy pair (Monday Dip + WCDS, MonFri + WCDS, Monthly Weak Close + MonFri) at the existing 20 bps nominal per side. MonFri SPY+QQQ untouched (its both-fire days earn 3.1x at 2.1x sd).
changes.math: IOB both-fire days: 50 of 133 signal days, leg-R correlation 0.88, day mean 1.9x a single-leg day at 2.3x the sd; at rho ~1 Kelly puts each ticket at half. Cross-strategy same-ticker pairs: 14 since 2010, R correlation 0.97. Variance-only: expected PnL -$1.3k/yr on the IOB cell, ~0 on the clamp.
changes.expected_effect: Both-day IOB sd 2.3x -> 1.15x of a single-leg day at a cost of about -$1.3k/yr; the cross-strategy clamp removes doubled tickets with no expected-value content.
changes.confidence: high that the cost is small; these are variance rules with no edge claim
changes.evidence: dynamic_sizing_plan L2 index-clones section; kelly_read_same_ticker_2026-09-02.py
changes.risks: None material; a rho = 1 clamp cannot be wrong about expectancy, only about variance preference.
changes.intuition: Two tickets on one horse.
changes.base_rate_support: Kelly Rung 3 at rho = 1.
changes.implementation_notes: Same machinery as the cross-strategy overlap clamp (daily_scan 5b, strat_backtester 3b3c), keyed within IOB for the pair; extend the OVERRIDES list; tests/test_cross_strategy_overlap (existing pattern).

changes.name: No 52wh Breakout depth rule (rejects the baseline plan's 0.5x at >= 5 open and the adds study's >= 6 variant)
changes.rule: No open-count multiplier on 52wh Breakout. Its tail (27% of worst-5%-day losses for 14.5% of PnL; Feb-2014 window 88% deep-stack legs) is carried by AL-1's 0.70 base cut and by the P4 exit prereg (dial-conditioned hold shortening), not by a depth rung.
changes.math: >= 6 open vs rest: -0.10R, episode-bootstrap P(<= 0) 0.57, 90% CI [-0.74, +0.74], sign flips by era (pre-2010 0.92R, 2010+ 0.08R on 23 legs, 4 episodes); exact-5 cell 1.71R (N 13). Posterior multiplier 1.00 (P(real) 0.18, E[delta] -0.004R). Replays: >= 5 at 0.5x -$68.5k raw / -$9.4k equal risk; >= 6 at 0.5x -$34.6k raw (nearly all pre-2010), +$7.5k equal risk; the walk-forward edge rule on 52wh depth LOSES (0.440 vs 0.527).
changes.expected_effect: Avoids a -$35k to -$69k raw cost for a cell whose expectancy posterior is zero; the only thing a >= 6 cut buys is the Feb-2014-shaped worst-21d (-59.5k -> -33.3k), which is one episode.
changes.confidence: high that no expectancy rule exists; moderate that the tail is better handled at L1 and P4
changes.evidence: within_strategy_adds_results.json f7; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json 52WH-DEEP6; dynamic_sizing_plan L2/L3 (52wh Sharpe -2.2 at dial >= 50 on 125 active days is an EXIT question)
changes.risks: If McKinley wants the Feb-2014 tail insured regardless, the honest form is the >= 6 variant labelled tail insurance with a written re-exam at +15 legs; it is not an evidenced edge and the plan says so.
changes.intuition: Breakout clusters are a late-stage market condition, but 40 legs across five years and two eras with opposite signs is not a rule, it is a story.
changes.base_rate_support: Daniel-Moskowitz: momentum's crash state is bear-market + high variance, a regime the P4 exit rule targets directly; per-position depth is not the variable the literature supports.
changes.implementation_notes: Remove decision #3 from the baseline plan's register; keep the n_eff display item (#9).

changes.name: Flow-aware per-strategy daily cap: 250 -> 375 bps effective on the family's top-tercile 5d raw-candidate days
changes.rule: cap_bps = 250 normally; 375 (x1.5) for every strategy in a family on any day the family's trailing-5d RAW candidate count (inclusive of today, counted from the same filter masks daily_scan evaluates, BEFORE earnings blackout / T+1 gates / fill windows) is >= its tercile threshold: dip_buy >= 6, oversold_hold >= 7, short_fade >= 104. Breakout family unchanged (cap never binds there). Never above x1.5 (full removal blows the OVS tail: Sharpe 1.18 -> 0.93, maxDD -44k -> -127k). GATED BY GM-2: on a day the margin guard would fire, the cap stays 250.
changes.math: Cap binds on 20.9% of trades (130 strategy-days); avgR on cap-bound vs unbound: OVS 0.62 vs 0.20 (101 days, mean scale 0.35), WCDS 0.96 vs 0.24, 3x ETF Fade 1.25 vs 0.52, OLV 1.59 vs 0.69. Posterior on the bound-vs-unbound OVS contrast (d +0.42, se 0.12): P(real) 0.97, mult 1.43. Unfitted replay 2010-2026 (thresholds from pre-2010 data): book PnL +3.8% (+$132k), risk +2.0%, PnL/risk 0.491 -> 0.499, Sharpe 2.199 -> 2.222, maxDD -$92,866 vs -$92,867, worst-21d identical, 10/17 years better and 7 identical. Per family: dip_buy +2.4% (Sharpe 1.52 -> 1.54), short_fade +8.3% (1.18 -> 1.18), oversold_hold +3.1% (1.33 -> 1.30).
changes.expected_effect: +3.8% book PnL (~+$8k/yr flat) with Sharpe up 0.02 and maxDD / worst-21d byte-identical in the replay; the cleanest flow rule in the pack because it is mechanical (the cap pro-rates exactly the high-expectancy days).
changes.confidence: moderate-high: unfitted thresholds, mechanism is arithmetic, tails unchanged; verify live placed totals vs the ledger's implied ones first
changes.evidence: flow_conditional_results.json f6 and recommendation 1; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json OVS-CAPBOUND; CLAUDE.md Daily Risk Caps (the per-strategy 250 is kept for the worst single day, which x1.5 on hi-flow days leaves unchanged in the replay)
changes.risks: Raises gross on exactly the cluster days that set the margin wall (2023-02-03 is an OVS + 3x fade cluster), hence the GM-2 gate. The replay keeps the same fills at larger size and ignores impact on 9+ signal OVS baskets. Live counts must be raw masks, not staged rows, or every threshold shifts (OVS raw candidates ~16x fills).
changes.intuition: The cap is a scalar throttle on the days the book is paid to be big. Lifting it by half on those days, and only those, keeps the worst-day bound and stops fighting the edge.
changes.base_rate_support: Nagel: liquidity-provision returns spike when many names dislocate at once; Frazzini-Israel-Moskowitz cost regressions say a $100-150k order in liquid names costs 2-8 bps, so the extra size is not eaten by impact in the liquid tier.
changes.implementation_notes: order_staging.py PER_STRAT_DAILY_CAP_BPS becomes a per-day function of a family flow flag written by daily_scan (new column Family_Flow_Hi on staging rows plus a scan-email line); engine process_signals_fast cap_bps x strat mult hook already exists; build_trade_ledger aligned. Family map: dip_buy = FAMILY4 + Monthly Weak Close + 3x Bear Fade + St OS Sznl; oversold_hold = OLV + LT Trend; short_fade = OVS + ATR Ext + 3x ETF Fade + 3x Leader (per flow_conditional_lib). Post-ship review: cap-bound-day avgR on the first 40 relieved days >= 0.4, else revert.

changes.name: Up-only family flow multiplier 1.2x on top-tercile 5d candidate days
changes.rule: New sizing step after 2b and before the OLV ladder: mult = 1.2 when the family's trailing-5d raw candidate count >= threshold (dip_buy >= 6 AND 10d-MA 63d dial < 50; oversold_hold >= 7; short_fade >= 104), else 1.0. No down-size leg (the 0.75x low-flow leg costs 5.7% PnL for 9.1% less risk and is a variance rule, not an edge rule). No breakout carrier. Composes multiplicatively (first-iteration OLV on a hi-flow day = 0.5 x 1.2 = 0.6x). Post-ship review written now: PnL per unit risk on the first 60 hi-flow trades >= 1.3x the concurrent lo/mid-flow trades, else retire.
changes.math: Top-tercile vs rest: dip_buy +0.20R (se 0.074, t 2.7), oversold_hold +0.35R (se 0.117, t 3.0), short_fade +0.30R (se 0.094, t 3.2); per-year Spearman positive 82-84% of 22 years; survives VIX / SPY trend / realized vol / drawdown / dial controls (t 4.1-4.3 dip, 3.6-4.3 oversold, 2.3-3.4 short). Posteriors (pi1 0.35, tau 0.25): 1.17 / 1.23 / 1.33; 1.2 is the shrunk common value. Unfitted 1.25x up-only replay 2010-2026, cap re-applied: book PnL +5.0% at +4.2% risk, Sharpe 2.197 (flat), maxDD -$92.9k -> -$102.8k, 17/17 years better, worst year +1%; at 1.2x expect +4% PnL at +3.4% risk. Combined with FL-1 at 1.25: +9.9% PnL, +6.8% risk, Sharpe 2.224, 17/17 years.
changes.expected_effect: About +4% book PnL (~+$8k/yr flat) at +3.4% risk deployed, Sharpe flat, maxDD ~+8%; a growth lever, not a Sharpe lever, which is exactly the kind of appetite the brief invites.
changes.confidence: moderate: expectancy evidence strong and control-robust, but the high-flow legs are one correlated bet so daily Sharpe does not move; the dip_buy dial gate is evidenced (hi-lo +0.03R at dial >= 30, t 0.1)
changes.evidence: flow_conditional_results.json f1, f2, f5; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json FLOW-DIP / FLOW-OSH / FLOW-SF; seasonality_flow f5 (OVS same-day >= 5: 0.648 vs 0.230, q 0.002, posterior 1.48); the plan's L4 finding that signal density predicts vol AND mean
changes.risks: Thresholds are the 2026 expanding-window terciles (in-sample for the level); hi-flow episodes are few for oversold_hold (20) and short_fade (26); 2026's two OVS cluster days lost (-0.90, -1.10). Fills-only outcomes conditional on staged flow. Adds gross on cluster days (GM-2 gate applies).
changes.intuition: When many setups fire together the book is being paid to provide liquidity; the crowded-selloff reading is wrong-signed for every mean-reverting family in this book.
changes.base_rate_support: Nagel 2012 (reversal Sharpe rises with dislocation breadth / VIX); Daniel-Moskowitz loser-decile up-betas; contradicted only by Collin-Dufresne-Daniel on the VIX link, not on breadth.
changes.implementation_notes: daily_scan step 2c0: count raw candidates per family from the shared filter masks over the trailing 5 sessions (the flow_conditional_lib definition); stamp Family_Flow_Count / Family_Flow_Mult on staging rows; strat_backtester candidate pre-pass mirrors it (candidates ARE mask days, so engine == scan); OVS keeps its own P2 cap. Guard test: threshold boundaries, dial gate for dip_buy only, no breakout carrier.

changes.name: OVS path-2 aggregate daily cap 0.75% -> 1.0% nominal (half-step)
changes.rule: strategy_config OVS execution path2_daily_cap_pct: 0.75 -> 1.0 (nominal; x GRM = 1.5% effective after GM-1's 1.875 it becomes 1.875%). Per-strategy cap unchanged. Review after one year: if the capped-P2 cell's realized avgR stays above the uncapped cell's, take the second half-step to 1.5.
changes.math: 202 of 609 P2 trades capped; capped avgR +0.37 vs uncapped +0.18 (d +0.19, se ~0.13, t 1.5); posterior (pi1 0.29 geometric, tau 0.25): P(real) 0.30, mult 1.11. Full uncapping: +$49.5k over 24 years (8.1% of OVS PnL), worst single-day extra loss -$1.4k, best +$11.9k, positive in 11 of 14 capping years. A half-step captures roughly 40% of that.
changes.expected_effect: About +$20k over 24 years (+$0.8k/yr), worst extra day well under $1k; the per-strategy 250 cap still bounds the day.
changes.confidence: low-moderate (t 1.5, cluster-year concentrated); the downside is bounded by the per-strategy cap, which is why a half-step is acceptable at this posterior
changes.evidence: signal_quality_results.json f3 / recommendation 2; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json OVS-P2CAP
changes.risks: Concentrated in 2009/2016/2020/2021/2023 cluster years; interacts with FL-1 on the same days; engine replay needed.
changes.intuition: The P2 cap trims the best P2 days and bounds almost nothing.
changes.base_rate_support: Same cluster-day logic as FL-1.
changes.implementation_notes: One constant in strategy_config; order_staging reads the row stamp Path2_Daily_Cap_Pct so it flows automatically; tests/test_ovs_scaleout.py invariants unaffected.

changes.name: Dial-armed whole-book beta hedge: paper-track at 50/45 with a 126d (or shrunk) beta, then ship
changes.rule: armed = hysteresis(10d-MA 63d dial, lag-1: arm >= 50, release < 45). Hedge = short ES/MES sized to beta_hat x NAV, beta_hat = 126-session lag-1 OLS of the flat-basis book return on SPY (or 0.5 x 63d + 0.5 x expanding), clipped [-1, 2], refreshed daily, ratio 1.0x, never above 1.0x. Target = WHOLE book (not the dip-buy family). Paper-track one full armed episode on the hedge panel (already display-only) with beta_126, beta_63, realized armed beta and drift-to-date logged; ship after that episode if realized armed beta is within [0.2, 0.8] and the panel's P&L attribution reconciles. Second-stage sensitivity registered now, decision rule fixed: adopt the VIX < 20 arming gate with release at VIX >= 30 only if it is not worse than plain 50/45 over the next two out-of-sample armed episodes.
changes.math: PIT vintage 2018-2026 at 50/45: 544 armed days, 13 episodes, +$104.3k, 10 of 13 positive, mean +$8.0k/episode, clustered t 1.68, Sharpe 2.90 -> 3.04, maxDD -8.32% -> -8.13%, LOYO 7/9, episode bootstrap P(<= 0) 0.046, placebo rank 1.000, drop-best +$71k t 1.27; 126d beta +$110k, Sharpe 3.07, maxDD -7.89%. Live vintage +$35k, t 0.72. Two-groups posterior on the episode mean (pi1 0.5 pre-registered, tau $8k): P(real) 0.59, E[episode] +$3.5k, ~+$4.5k/yr at 1.3 episodes/yr (0.6% NAV). 65/60: P(real) 0.47, +$1.8k/episode (a Feb-2020 result). VIX-gated variant: P(real) 0.29 after pricing the 12-variant search.
changes.expected_effect: Expected +$3.5k per armed episode after shrinkage (+$4.5k/yr), full-sample Sharpe +0.07 to +0.15 if the PIT result holds, maxDD -0.2 to -0.4 pt, calm carry ~-$5k/yr from false alarms (4 of 10 live episodes). Removes ~6% of armed-day book sd; the value is the dial's negative SPY drift forecast, not variance reduction.
changes.confidence: moderate: it is the one dial-conditioned control that clears PIT, but 13 episodes, drift-driven, and the posterior expected value is small; paper-track first is the robust choice
changes.evidence: cross_strategy_regime_results.json f3, f4, f5, f6; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json hedge block; dynamic_sizing_plan P1 ship rule (passed on PIT with margin)
changes.risks: Daniel-Moskowitz: ex-ante beta hedges of state-dependent-beta strategies under-hedge the loss side and sell the rebound (book up-beta 0.50 vs down-beta 0.27 while armed); the book's beta is highest in calm tape, so only a dial-armed form has the right sign and it inherits signal-definition lookahead PIT cannot cure. Futures margin is additive (does not relax GM-2). 42d/63d betas have zero predictive correlation with realized beta while armed (0.02 / -0.04); 126d is 0.20.
changes.intuition: The dial does not move book variance, it moves composition: at 65+ the book is 3.5x more of a market bet. A scalar cut shrinks the idiosyncratic Kelly book by the same factor as the market exposure it wanted to remove; a hedge removes only the factor, and only when its conditional mean has turned.
changes.base_rate_support: One-factor Kelly decomposition w_m = mu_m/sigma_m^2 - beta' w_idio (hedge the embedded beta when mu_m < 0); Longin-Solnik and Ang-Chen say correlation rises with bear TREND, which is why VIX-armed forms lose (-$158k, 0/15 episodes) and the dial-armed form is the only candidate.
changes.implementation_notes: Hedge panel already reads /exec-book, futures_specs.json and betas.json; add beta_126 and the armed flag to build_betas.py output; MES contracts = beta x NAV / (50 x ES); native MOC per the 2026-08-21 encoding rule; quarterly roll on the panel's roll-off schedule; all arm/release events journaled. Nothing places until the paper episode is logged.

changes.name: LT Trend ST OS band [[50, 999, 0.75]] as a fresh pre-registration (not shipped)
changes.rule: Candidate: frag_risk_bands for LT Trend ST OS = [[50, 999, 0.75]], plain table (not P/C-conditioned). Because the P2 threshold was moved from 65 to 50 AFTER seeing the PIT tables, this needs a new registration under CLAUDE.md's rule. Decision rule fixed now: adopt only if, on the live PIT-vintage series extended by two NEW hi-dial episodes, the [50, 999) cell's clustered t <= -2.0, the effect survives drop-best-episode, and the episode sign count is >= 6 of 11; the adds cell (AD-2's 1.2x legs) is scored separately and exempt if its own cell stays >= 0.4R.
changes.math: PIT 2018+: LT Trend at dial >= 50 avgR 0.107 (N 62) vs 0.482 (N 87), diff -0.375, clustered t -2.33 (9 episodes, 5 negative / 4 positive), drop-best -0.336, LOYO -0.48..-0.28; at 65+ t -1.80 (fails). Posterior (pi1 0.35, tau 0.25): P(real) 0.67, E[delta] -0.18R, mult 0.72 -> 0.75 band. Single-strategy WF 2019+: PPR +14%, 5/6 years, Sharpe 1.00 -> 1.14; fixed 0.5x: book Sharpe +0.01, +$47k risk-matched over 8y; at 0.75x roughly half.
changes.expected_effect: About +$20-25k over 8 years if adopted; the value is removing the one exemption that fails on PIT, not dollars.
changes.confidence: low-moderate (9 episodes, two of them carry 28 of 62 trades; threshold chosen post hoc)
changes.evidence: cycle_macro_results.json f5 and recommendation 3; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json LTT-PIT50; CLAUDE.md pre-registration requirement
changes.risks: Overlaps AD-2 (at 65+ LT's cluster adds are its only legs with edge: 0.63R vs solo -0.12R); a band that cuts adds would be wrong-signed, hence the exemption clause.
changes.intuition: An intermediate-term uptrend dip-buy is the strategy most exposed to a fragile-at-highs distribution rolling over (daily beta 0.27, highest of the exempt three).
changes.base_rate_support: Same FAMILY4 logic (beta-long dip-buys into a distribution) with the plan's own PIT discipline.
changes.implementation_notes: Prereg doc under scratch/ultracode_research/ with the rule above; no code until it passes.

changes.name: FAMILY4 / P/C-fear bands: unchanged now, but the post-ship review's fallback is written as 0.5x, not 0.25x/zero
changes.rule: frag_risk_bands and PC_FEAR_BANDS stay as shipped (McKinley's appetite decisions). Two written commitments: (1) once XS-1 is live, re-score the 0.25x band and the fear-OFF zeroing on HEDGED trade returns (the hedge removes part of what fails at high dial); (2) if the 2026-08-05 prereg's post-ship review fails, the band reverts to [[50, 999, 0.5]] rather than to 1.0x, because the robust posterior sits at 0.80-0.90x and the outside base rate points the other way.
changes.math: PIT FAMILY4 hi -0.10R vs lo +0.63R (diff -0.73, clustered t -1.96, 6/9 years negative). Two-groups posterior (pi1 0.35, tau 0.25): P(real) 0.45, E[delta] -0.10R, mult 0.90; at tau 0.40: 0.80. The live 0.25x (fear OFF: 0.0x) is 3-4x more aggressive than the shrunk evidence; the 1.25x fear-ON boost in calm tape rests on 19 trades / 3 episodes and has posterior ~1.0.
changes.expected_effect: None now. Prevents the review from swinging between 0.25x and 1.0x on one more episode; anchors the fallback at the posterior.
changes.confidence: moderate on the posterior; the decision is the principal's appetite and this only fixes the fallback
changes.evidence: CLAUDE.md Fragility Risk Bands + P/C bands sections; robust_bayes_02_rule_shrinkage.json FAM4-DIAL50; Nagel 2012 and the margin study's contested point (reversal edge rises with VIX; the dial is not VIX and the band fires at dial-high / VIX-low)
changes.risks: Re-scoring on hedged returns needs an engine rerun with bands off (the daily series cannot undo them).

what_not_to_do: Do not add any book-level scalar: vol target (EWMA, VIX-inverse, rv-power), dial step/taper, open-leg 1/sqrt(n), correlation-spike or effective-N de-risking, signal-cluster throttle. Nine overlays sit at or below baseline at equal vol (2.54-2.83 vs 2.81), PIT throttle t -0.23, taper -11.4R; cluster days (5-6 strategies active) have beta 1.13 but Sharpe 4.7 and 58 bps/day. Cederburg et al: real-time vol management underperforms across 103 strategies; DeMiguel et al: vol-scaling the beta leg LOSES 0.12 Sharpe OOS.

Do not add drawdown-triggered de-risking (Grossman-Zhou continuous or Millennium-style 5%/7.5% steps). New evidence this session (robust_bayes_01_grm.json D): book daily PnL autocorrelation is NEGATIVE (ACF1 -0.03 / -0.06 vs se 0.013 / 0.019; VR5 0.88, VR21 0.84; monthly ACF1 +0.08 n.s.) and the 21d-forward mean conditional on a 5-10% drawdown is 22-55% annualized, at or above the unconditional 22-33%. Kaminski-Lo: a stop on a mean-reverting P&L series has a negative stopping premium; Man 2025: a 20% cut-off rule costs 2.2%/yr on uncorrelated Sharpe-0.5 strategies.

Do not arm any hedge or cut on VIX level, VIX percentile, realized vol or SPY drawdown: VIX >= 25 hedge -$158.5k (0 of 15 episodes positive, t -3.85), VIX pctile -$154k, SPY dd -$139k, always-hedged -$478k with maxDD -8.3% -> -11.5%. The book's beta is HIGHEST in calm tape (VIX < 15: 0.52) and lowest after vol arrives (VIX 30+: 0.17, Sharpe 3.8); Longin-Solnik: correlation rises with bear trend, not vol.

The plan's '65+ book avgR halves' cell is +0.006R on PIT. Every dial-conditioned claim is re-scored on the PIT series before it sizes anything.
