Do not cite the OLV 0.5x-at-65 band, the OLV book cap, the 1.25x fear-ON boost, the OVS P1-budget gate, the pooled 500L/250S caps, the sector loss gate, or the ML P(win) layer as evidence for anything: each is recorded closed in CLAUDE.md (win rate and expectancy are decoupled in this book; any 'quality' claim must be about avgR / R per unit risk, which is why AD-3 is admissible and a P(win) tier is not).

Do not treat the drawdown tables as the sizing constraint: the binding boundary is a forced liquidation at 15:45 ET on a cluster day whose margin rate is uncertain (m 1.01 under rules-based short-3x vs 1.63-1.80 under TIMS), which no bootstrap of daily returns can see.
narrative: The skeptic's plan starts from three facts the evidence pack established and this session re-derived under uncertainty. First, growth is monotone in size everywhere the account can go: integrating the log-growth curve over a Beta prior on the keep fraction of the ledger mean (mean 0.58, 5-95% 0.34-0.79) gives argmax m >= 6 under every draw, both windows, and even at keep 0.30 the step from m 1 to m 1.25 adds 1.3-2.1 points of annual growth (2.9-4.4 at the prior mean). Curvature never argues against a step; only boundaries do. Second, the boundary is the broker, and its location is a discrete unknown: with TIMS class rates (stock 15%, broad ETF 8%, 3x 45%) the historical max requirement day is 55-61% of $750k (m 1.63-1.80; 1.37-1.52 on the $632k live NLV), but if IBKR applies rules-based 90% to short 3x ETFs the 2023-02-03 book (3x ETF Overbot Fade 0.97 NAV gross plus OVS 0.75) already needs 99% of $750k at m 1.0 and 117% of live NLV. A Bayesian cannot pick m 1.5 while that fact is unresolved, so the plan makes the IBKR what-if and a margin-feasibility guard (denominated in broker requirement, not notional, and firing only on projected infeasibility) preconditions of GRM 1.875, and makes GRM 2.25 a second step gated on a MEASURED live keep. Third, every conditional rule was priced against its base rate of being noise with a two-groups model (P(real) from provenance and from the analysis' own excess of hits over the null, effect shrunk by se against a 0.25R scale of real effects, half-Kelly on the tilt). The survivors and their posterior multipliers: OVS bottom-extremity 0.68 (ship at 0.7, not the fitted 0.5), family flow top tercile 1.17-1.33 (ship 1.2 up-only, dip_buy gated dial < 50), OVS cap-bound days 1.43 (ship as cap 250 -> 375 on hi-flow days, tails byte-identical), OLV 3-10% pullback 1.17 (ship 1.15 after engine replay), WCDS / LT adds 1.24 / 1.29 and solo ~0.8 (ship 0.8/1.2), OLV depth 1.09 / solo 0.91 (the 0.5x ladder is appetite; re-key it to max(recency, depth) so the cut stays on the weak cell), LT Trend at PIT dial 50 0.72 (prereg at 0.75, threshold was post hoc), OVS P2 cap 1.11 (half-step), the dial-armed hedge +$3.5k per episode at P(real) 0.59 (paper-track then ship). The failures, all within 0.03 of 1.0: 52wh depth (1.00), family near-high alpha part (0.97), 52wh calm-tape (0.92), dip-buy summer (0.955), earnings season (1.01), and the FAMILY4 0.25x/zero band (0.80-0.90, kept as the principal's appetite with its fallback pinned at 0.5x). Relative allocation moves to trusted edge: running the plan's Sigma^-1 mu route on keep-adjusted means with a 0.7-1.3 clip keeps the unanimous ranking (cut 52wh, WCDS, Sector BO, St OS, IOB; raise MonFri, 3x ETF Fade, OLV, ATR Ext, Monday Dip), adds 3.2 points of NAV a year with maxDD 0.7 pt BETTER, PnL/maxDD +20%, and a worst held-out year of -4% versus the plan's -12.6% (keep-vector lookahead flagged). Two new negative results close doors: book daily PnL is mean-reverting (ACF1 -0.03/-0.06, VR21 0.84; forward mean after a 5-10% drawdown 22-55% annualized), so by Kaminski-Lo any drawdown-triggered cut is expected-return negative; and the margin wall under the pessimistic reading is a 3x-fade cluster day, not the dip-buy cluster the pack identified. Expected effect of the whole package on the flat basis, prior mean: ledger PnL ~$157k/yr -> ~$255k/yr (x1.25 GRM, x1.13 tilt, x1.08 flow package, +$15k adds/OLV/P2, +$4.5k hedge), book vol 11.5-12.5% -> ~15-16.5%, 1y median maxDD ~8.5% with P(> 15%) 4-9% at keep 0.60 and 17-20% at keep 0.30; expected LIVE PnL at keep 0.60 ~$150k/yr versus ~$94k today. Sequencing: (0) M-1 what-if, fills harvest, engine costs, headroom monitor; (1) variance-only clamps AD-4, OLV re-key AD-1, AD-2, AD-3, AL-1 through the engine gate; (2) FL-1 and FL-2 behind GM-2, FL-3; (3) GRM 1.875; (4) hedge paper episode then ship, XS-2 and RG-1 preregs; (5) GRM 2.25 after >= 150 matched fills at keep >= 0.5 and index legs on futures or a guard that has fired cleanly. What would move me: a measured live keep above 0.70 on 150 fills (go to 2.25 and widen the tilt clip to 0.6-1.4) or below 0.40 (hold 1.5, tilt only); an IBKR what-if confirming TIMS on 3x (wall at m 1.6-1.8, guard rarely binds) or rules-based (guard is load-bearing and the 3x fades' cluster-day gross is the book's binding tail); two new hi-dial episodes with the paper hedge positive (ship) or both negative (park, and the FAMILY4 cut regains standing); the first 60 hi-flow trades earning >= 1.3x the concurrent lo/mid PnL per unit risk (keep FL-2) or not (retire it, keep FL-1); OLV and LT Trend recovering in 2027 Q1-Q2 (keep their raises) or not (revert to 1.0); and the FAMILY4 re-score on hedged returns, which decides whether the 0.25x band is doing work the hedge already does.

lens: growth-maximizer (Kelly purist under margin and liquidity constraints only; no drawdown appetite constraint)
thesis: The book runs at 7-15% of its own haircut Kelly (Sharpe 1.2-1.6 after a 40% haircut, full-Kelly multiple 10-13x current size), so log growth is linear in size through every multiple the account can physically carry and the growth curve has nothing to say against any GRM below the broker's wall. The binding constraints are portfolio margin on 5-10 historical cluster days (2023-02-03 3x-fade short cluster and the 2016-06-14 / 2019-06-26 / 2024-05-24 broad-and-sector-ETF dip-buy clusters), the per-strategy 250 bps cap that clips exactly the highest-expectancy days, and estimation error in mu, not variance and not drawdown. The plan therefore (1) raises GRM to the TIMS-tiered margin boundary on live NLV (2.25 now, rule-driven step to 3.0), (2) reallocates the risk budget toward strategies with the highest haircut mu/sigma^2 per dollar of margin (keep-weighted Kelly tilt, which is also 35% margin-cheaper than equal weights), (3) sizes every add, stack and flow state by marginal expected R and never by marginal variance (OLV depth ladder, OVS 375 cap, WCDS/LT solo 0.75 / adds 1.25, flow-day 1.25x and cap x1.5), (4) removes the one embedded factor bet with negative conditional drift through the dial-armed whole-book beta hedge, the only dial control that survives point-in-time weights, and (5) keeps every scalar, calendar, correlation and drawdown-triggered control off, because each was replayed at or below baseline and the book's daily P&L is mean-reverting (negative ACF), which makes any stop-loss on the P&L series expected-value negative.

grm.value: 2.25 now (m = 1.5x current sizing); rule-driven step to 3.0 (m = 2.0) when EITHER live NLV >= ~$840k OR the order_staging margin guard (GM-2) is live AND IBKR's what-if confirms 3x ETFs are margined at the 45% TIMS stress rather than the 75/90% rules-based rate. Overflow-tier LONG strategies are excluded from the step (GM-6): their effective bps stay at today's GRM-1.5 level.
grm.rationale: Rule: GRM = 1.5 x m, m = NLV / (750k x R_max) where R_max is the historical maximum TIMS-tiered requirement/NAV at current sizing (0.56 on 2023-02-03: broad idx 8%, small-cap idx 10%, single/sector 15%, 3x 45%, cheap-short per-share floors; growthmax_1_margin_tiered.json). At NLV $632k: m = 1.51, GRM 2.27, rounded to 2.25. The p99 requirement day (35% NAV) binds only at m = 2.39 on live NLV (GRM 3.59), so once the guard converts the 1-2 max days per decade into a planned pro-rata haircut instead of a 15:45 ET auto-liquidation, the rule's max-day term is replaced by the p99 term with a 15% cushion: m = 0.85 x NLV / (750k x 0.35) = 2.05 at today's NLV, GRM 3.0. Growth theory is silent between these points: exact E[log(1+m r)] at the measured 40% haircut is 12.9% / 18.8% / 24.5% / 34.8% per year at m = 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 3 on 2003+ and 19.3% / 28.4% / 37.0% / 53.3% on 2016+ (growthmax_2), i.e. linear to within 1 pt through m = 3; the haircut-Kelly optimum sits at m 10.5-14 (GRM 16-21) and the GPD single-day-ruin boundary at m 6.5-9, both unreachable. The step from 1.5 to 2.25 adds +5.9 to +9.1 pts/yr of log growth at the 40% haircut (+10.4 to +15.7 before haircut); to 3.0 adds +11.6 to +17.7 pts. Fractional-Kelly cross-check: at GRM 2.25 the book is c = 0.12-0.15 of haircut Kelly (growth share 22-27%), still below Thorp/Benter/Ziemba's 25-50% practitioner band and below Carver's 25%-of-backtest-Kelly rule; at GRM 3.0 c = 0.16-0.19. Liquidity is not a boundary at either level (sqrt-impact drag 5.2% NAV/yr at m 1.5, 8.0% at m 2; book edge halves at m ~58). The per-strategy 250 cap costs 1 pt of growth at m 1.5 and 3 pts at m 2 and is kept fixed except where the within-strategy evidence says the cap-bound days are the best days (OVS 375, flow-day x1.5). Decisive open question before the step: whether IBKR takes the higher of rules-based and portfolio margin on 3x ETFs; if it does, the CURRENT book needs 99% of NAV on 2023-02-03 and the 3x-fade sleeve's cluster-day gross must be bounded first (its margin per dollar of ATR risk is 18.6 under rules vs 9.3 under PM vs 5-6 for the rest of the book).
grm.drawdown_accepted: At GRM 2.25 with the L1 tilt, 40% haircut, block bootstrap (mean block 10, 3000 paths, growthmax_2 scaled by the tilt's 1.2x maxDD ratio): 1-year compounded maxDD median ~11-12% (9.5% 2016+ / 10.4% 2003+ before the tilt), p95 ~20-23%, P(1y DD > 15%) 10-19%, P(1y DD > 20%) 2-5%, P(1y DD > 30%) < 1%; 3-year maxDD median ~15-18%, P(3y DD > 20%) 9-21%, P(3y DD > 30%) 0-2%, P(3y DD > 50%) 0%; 3y terminal wealth median 1.7-2.3x with p5 1.13-1.45x (P(3y loss) 0-2%). Actual 2003-2026 path at m 1.5: compounded maxDD 17% (2016+: 12%), worst day -8.8%; with the tilt's wider tail ~20% and ~-10%. GBM lifetime P(ever DD >= 20%) 2.8-5.8%, P(ever DD >= 50%) ~0.0-0.1%. Median time from trough of the year's worst drawdown to a new high 14-30 sessions (unchanged with m; the book's drawdowns are short). At GRM 3.0: 1y median 12.5-13.7% (~15-16% with tilt), p95 23-26%, P(1y > 20%) 9-18%, P(1y > 30%) 1-2%; 3y median 17-20%, P(3y > 20%) 31-52%, P(3y > 30%) 3-10%; actual path 22% (2016+: 16%) and worst day -11.8%; GBM P(ever DD >= 20%) 7-13%. Forced-liquidation risk at GRM 2.25 on plain TIMS: the max-day requirement exactly equals live NLV (no cushion) on the single 2023-02-03-type day per decade; requirement > 70% of NAV on ~0.5 days/yr; with the guard live the residual is a planned same-day haircut. P(requirement > equity within 3y) at m 1.5 on plain PM: 0.1-0.4%; at m 2: 14-23% without the guard (which is why the step to 3.0 is conditional on it).

changes.name: GLOBAL_RISK_MULTIPLIER 1.5 -> 2.25 by a margin-feasibility rule (no drawdown constraint)
changes.rule: GRM = 1.5 x m with m = min over scenarios of NLV / (750k x R), R = historical maximum TIMS-tiered requirement/NAV at current sizing (0.56, 2023-02-03) until the margin guard (GM-2) is live, then R = p99 requirement/NAV (0.35) with a 15% cushion. Re-derived whenever NLV moves 20%, when the rate assumptions are replaced by IBKR what-if numbers, and quarterly. Today: m = 632/(750 x 0.56) = 1.51 -> GRM 2.25. With the guard live and the 45% 3x rate confirmed: m = 0.85 x 632/(750 x 0.35) = 2.05 -> GRM 3.0. Overflow-tier longs excluded (GM-6).
changes.math: g(m) = E[log(1 + m r)] x 252 on the flat daily series with mean haircut 40%: 2003+ 12.9 / 15.9 / 18.8 / 21.7 / 24.5 / 27.1 / 34.8% at m 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 / 2.25 / 3; 2016+ 19.3 / 23.9 / 28.4 / 32.7 / 37.0 / 41.2 / 53.3%. Quadratic check: g ~ m mu - m^2 sigma^2 / 2 with mu = 0.6 x 22.5% = 13.5%, sigma = 11.5%: g(1.5) = 18.8%, g(2) = 24.4%, curvature term at m 2 = 2.6 pts. Full haircut-Kelly m* = 10.3 (2003+) / 12.8 (2016+). Margin: requirement(m) = m x sum_i notional_i x rate_i; feasibility m_max = NLV/(750k x max_t req_t/NAV). Fraction of haircut Kelly at GRM 2.25: c = 1.5/10.3 = 0.146 (2003+), 1.5/12.8 = 0.117 (2016+); growth share c(2-c) = 0.27 / 0.22.
changes.expected_effect: Ledger-basis (before haircut) annualised log growth 21.9% -> 32.3% (2003+) and 32.7% -> 48.4% (2016+); at the 40% haircut 12.9% -> 18.8% and 19.3% -> 28.4%, i.e. +$44k to +$68k/yr of expected P&L on $750k at the haircut. Annualised vol 11.5-12.5% -> 17-19%. 1y median maxDD 7-10% -> 9.5-10.4%, p95 13.5-17.5% -> 17.5-19.8%, P(1y DD > 20%) 0-0.4% -> 2-5%. Actual-path 2003-2026 maxDD 12% -> 17%, worst day -5.9% -> -8.8%. Per-strategy 250 cap now binds on 2% of strategy-signal-days (cost ~1 pt growth). Liquidity drag 2.8% -> 5.2% NAV/yr at k = 1.
changes.confidence: moderate-high on growth and drawdown (three windows, five haircuts, four tail models agree the curve is linear here); moderate on the boundary (stylised TIMS rates; the 45% vs 90% 3x rate is the decisive unknown and must be read off IBKR's what-if before the step; the 2016-06-14 and 2023-02-03 books scaled by 1.5 are the test cases)
changes.evidence: growthmax_1_margin_tiered.json (scenarios tims_pm_cheapshort m_max_750 1.79, m_max_live 1.51, m_p99_live 2.39; tims_lev_rules m_max 1.01; flat15 reference 1.60); growthmax_2_growth_dd_acf.json (growth, drawdown 1y/3y at hc0.4, kelly_fraction); unconstrained_growth study (m* 9-19, GPD ruin m 6.5-9, cap-aware saturation ~4.6x, liquidity halving at m ~58, joint ruin bootstrap 0.1-0.4% at m 1.5 / 14-23% at m 2); estimation_haircut (40% central, 27-71% range); outside: Thorp 2006 g(c) = c(2-c), Busseti-Ryu-Boyd 2016 (risk-constrained optimum accepts P 0.10 of a 30% DD for 55-75% of full growth), Carver 2015 (25% of backtest Kelly).
changes.risks: (1) If IBKR's house margin is the rules-based 75/90% on 3x ETFs, the current book is already at 99% of NAV on 2023-02-03 and GRM 2.25 would sit at 149%: the step is then conditional on bounding the 3x-fade sleeve's cluster-day gross (the 250 cap already bounds it to ~2 days x 250 bps x 20 notional/risk ~ 100% NAV; scaling the fade base bps makes the cap bind more, not the notional grow). (2) A house-wide margin uplift (IBKR raised requirements up to 35% before the Nov-2020 election) moves the wall from 6.67x to 4.9x gross with a few weeks' notice: the guard (GM-2) is what keeps that a planned trim. (3) Drawdowns scale linearly with m and the book's daily P&L has positive monthly-sum autocorrelation (+0.07 to +0.12) despite negative daily ACF, so multi-month drawdowns run a little fatter than the block bootstrap shows. (4) The 40% haircut is a judgement envelope; at the 71% pessimistic bound the haircut-Kelly m* falls to 5-6.7 and GRM 2.25 is c = 0.24-0.30 of Kelly with lifetime P(DD >= 20%) 20-28%, still inside the practitioner band. (5) The live NLV ($632k) is below the $750k base, so live risk is already 1.19x the NAV-basis figure; all margin terms use live NLV, not the base.
changes.intuition: At 7-15% of Kelly you are paying for drawdown insurance you have said you do not want: every doubling of size roughly doubles growth until c approaches 0.25. The account, not the edge, sets the ceiling, and the ceiling is a handful of cluster days where the whole book is long the same washout or short the same 3x blow-off.
changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config.GLOBAL_RISK_MULTIPLIER 1.5 -> 2.25 (one line; every nominal scales at import). Before flipping: run IBKR Risk Navigator what-if on the ledger books of 2023-02-03, 2016-06-14, 2024-05-24 and 2019-06-26 scaled 1.5x and 2.0x; read the Exposure Fee Calculation Report at current size; record the 3x rate. Re-derive OVERFLOW_RISK_OVERRIDES per GM-6 in the same commit. GRM replay (scratch/grm_replay_study.py) at 2.25 with caps fixed as the confirmation, with the 250 cap and P2 cap held except per GM-11/GM-17.
changes.base_rate_support: Live-vs-backtest decay 26-73% (McLean-Pontiff, Suhonen, Harvey-Liu) is already inside the 40% haircut; practitioners run 25-50% of honest Kelly (Thorp, Benter, Ziemba), the book at GRM 2.25 is 12-27%; the Ziemba/MacLean simulations show the median-outcome frontier flat between 0.5 and 0.8 Kelly, so nothing is gained past ~0.5 of haircut Kelly even without a drawdown constraint (m ~5-6), which is far past the margin wall anyway.

changes.name: Margin-feasibility guard in order_staging (broker constraint, not an ATR-risk or notional cap)
changes.rule: Before the 9:31 chain: project the day's TIMS-tiered requirement = open book (live positions at last) + every staged entry at full size, on LIVE NLV. If projected requirement > 70% of NLV, scale that day's NEW entries pro rata (same mechanism as the per-strategy cap stage) until it equals 70%; never touch open positions. Second check at 15:30 ET (before Soft Edge Margin expires at 15:45): if the live requirement > 90% of NLV, trim the day's entries (not existing positions) MOC. Log every trim on the hedge panel with the day's requirement, the binding class and the strategies trimmed.
changes.math: req_t = sum_i n_i x p_i x rate(class_i, direction_i, p_i) with rate = 0.08 broad idx / 0.10 small-cap idx / 0.15 single & sector / 0.45 3x (0.75 long, 0.90 short if rules-based) / max(0.15 x notional, $5/share) for shorts under $16.67 / 100% under $5. Trigger frequency at 70% (2016+, current sizing scaled): m 1.5: 0.5 days/yr; m 1.75: 1.5; m 2: 2.6; m 2.5: 6.2; m 3: 12.7. At 100%: m 2: 0.1 days/yr, m 3: 3.4.
changes.expected_effect: Converts the forced-liquidation tail (P 14-23% within 3y at m 2 on plain PM, 33-48% with a 15% cushion, unconstrained_growth joint bootstrap) into a same-day planned haircut on 0.5-2.6 days/yr. Cost: those are the book's best days (gross > 100% NAV days are 15% of days and 49% of P&L, 44 bps/day vs 8), so at m 2 the guard forgoes on the order of 2.6 days x ~$5-15k of expected P&L per year, roughly 1-2% of annual P&L, against removing a 1-in-5 chance of a broker-timed liquidation at the worst prices. Unmeasured precisely: needs its own replay (guard on the ledger's staged rows).
changes.confidence: moderate: the arithmetic is mechanical; the cost is unmeasured and the rates are stylised
changes.evidence: growthmax_1 (guard_days_per_year_over_70pct / _100pct, top_requirement_days); unconstrained_growth 02/02b (ruin bootstrap, 'gross > 100% days = 49% of PnL'); broker base rates (IBKR TIMS stress grid, Soft Edge Margin to 15:45, no margin calls, automated real-time liquidation).
changes.risks: This is the one control in the plan that keys on notional, which McKinley rejects as a RISK control by design (no-notional-caps rule). It is not a risk control: it is the broker's constraint made visible one day early so the trim is pro rata by design instead of the broker's choice of positions. If that distinction is not accepted, GRM stays at 2.25 and the step to 3.0 is off. Second risk: the projected requirement is wrong (rates); the fix is the what-if calibration in GM-3.
changes.intuition: IBKR is going to enforce this constraint anyway, at 15:45, on whichever positions it picks. The only question is whether the trim is yours or theirs.
changes.implementation_notes: order_staging.py (OneDrive): new stage after the per-strategy cap, reading the live book from the /exec-book snapshot plus staged rows; class map = strategy_config.LEV3X_ALL + a broad/small-cap index set; NLV from the account summary. A dry-run mode that only logs for the first month. Engine parity: not modelled (like the OLV book cap); replay separately on the ledger's staged rows to price the cost.

changes.name: Margin headroom monitor + IBKR what-if calibration of the three cluster books
changes.rule: Daily, on the hedge panel beside the fragility dial: gross/NAV and net/NAV, blended TIMS rate, requirement/NLV (projected and live), distance to the 70% guard line, single-ticker concentration (max ticker notional / NLV), the -30% one-day equity-shock loss / NLV (exposure-fee proxy), and the 3x-ETF share of gross. One-off: run IBKR Risk Navigator what-if margin on the ledger books of 2023-02-03, 2016-06-14, 2024-05-24, 2019-06-26 at 1.0x, 1.5x and 2.0x; read the Exposure Fee report; record the 3x rate (45 vs 90) and the concentration threshold. Those four numbers replace the stylised rates in GM-1 and GM-2.
changes.math: Shock loss = 0.30 x max(0, net beta notional), beta = +1 stock/sector, +/-3 equity 3x by direction, 0 commodity/bond. At current size: p95 40% NAV, p99 69%, max 125% (2016-06-14, 418% net long); net beta notional > 100% NAV on ~25 days/yr. IBKR's fee criterion (scenario loss > equity) is met on ~1-2 days per decade at m 1 and more at m 1.5; it is a daily fee, not a liquidation.
changes.expected_effect: None on P&L; makes the size of the single market bet and the margin distance visible before the GRM step, and settles the two contested rate questions that decide whether GRM 3.0 is reachable.
changes.confidence: high (display); the what-if is the only way to resolve the 45/90 question
changes.evidence: growthmax_1 (exposure_pct_nav, equity_shock_30pct, margin_per_risk_by_strategy); broker base rates (undisclosed concentration trigger, 'higher of rules-based and PM' on 3x for some client categories, exposure fee on -30% scenario).
changes.risks: IBKR's formula is proprietary and can change; treat the what-if as a calibration that must be repeated after any house-rule notice.
changes.intuition: Nothing in the repo tracks gross-to-NAV even though OLV alone was at 84% of NAV on 2026-08-24; a size increase without the number on the screen is flying blind.
changes.implementation_notes: site/assets/execution.js hedge panel already reads /exec-book and betas.json; add the class map and TIMS rates client-side; scripts/build_betas.py could also emit per-symbol class. The what-if is manual in TWS Risk Navigator (custom scenario on the historical position lists exported from the ledger).

changes.name: Sizing base: flat $750k until live NLV exceeds it, then half-compounding; margin terms always on live NLV
changes.rule: Keep ACCOUNT_VALUE = 750,000 as the sizing base while NLV < 750k (a switch to NAV today is a 16% risk cut, not a growth step). When NLV > 750k: base = max(prior base, 0.5 x 750k + 0.5 x NLV), reset quarterly, never below the prior quarter. Full compounding only if the measured live-vs-ledger haircut comes in under 25%. GM-1's margin feasibility always uses live NLV regardless of the base.
changes.math: 10y block bootstrap, 2016+, m 1: flat median terminal 4.3x, full compounding 25.6x (p5 14.7x), half 9.0x; %-of-peak maxDD identical (9% median); dollar maxDD in units of initial capital p95: flat 13%, compounding 274%. 50% haircut, m 1.5, 3y: flat 1.74x vs compounding 1.98x (p5 1.24x), P(comp < flat on the same path) 9-24%.
changes.expected_effect: Captures most of the compounding growth (9x vs 25.6x vs 4.3x at 10y, no haircut) at half the dollar-drawdown growth; keeps the margin feasibility multiple constant in NAV terms because the quarterly reset re-derives GRM on the new NLV.
changes.confidence: moderate
changes.evidence: unconstrained_growth 04 (compounding policies); live NLV ~$632k (memory note 2026-08-18).
changes.risks: The flat base is a hidden de-leveraging rule that pays exactly in the bad first-year paths (P(comp < flat) 24% over 3y at the 50% haircut on 2003+); half-compounding halves that protection. Ratchet-only means a large drawdown does not shrink the base (by design under this lens).
changes.intuition: Compounding is the whole point of growth maximisation, but the account is currently smaller than the constant it sizes against, so the first step is to grow into the base, not to rebase.
changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config.ACCOUNT_VALUE becomes a quarterly-derived constant (recorded in the commit message with the NLV it was derived from); daily_scan / order_staging / engines read it unchanged. PA account keeps its own clamp.

changes.name: Per-strategy 250 bps/day cap: hold fixed through GRM 2.25 except the two evidenced relaxations; scale with GRM only past 3.0 as an explicit decision
changes.rule: PER_STRAT_DAILY_CAP_BPS stays 250 effective for every strategy except OVS (375, GM-17) and the flow-day relief (x1.5 on family top-tercile flow days, GM-14). Never remove it (x99 on OVS hi-flow days: Sharpe 1.18 -> 0.93, maxDD -$44k -> -$127k). If GRM ever exceeds 3.0, the cap becomes an explicit second decision (scale with GRM and accept a wider worst day, or accept a realised multiple that saturates near 4.6x).
changes.math: Realised risk-weighted multiple under the fixed cap: m 1.5 -> 1.48, 2 -> 1.93, 3 -> 2.68, 5 -> 3.69, 20 -> 4.59. Cap-fixed growth vs linear, 2016+: m 1.5 47.4% vs 48.4%; m 2 60.5% vs 63.7%; m 3 81.9% vs 93.3%. Share of strategy-signal-days bound: m 1.5 2%, m 2 4%, m 3 15%.
changes.expected_effect: Costs ~1 pt of growth at GRM 2.25 and ~3 pts at 3.0 while alone bounding the worst single day (-$44k vs -$118k uncapped, the entire uncapped maxDD in one day).
changes.confidence: high
changes.evidence: unconstrained_growth 01b (cap-aware series); flow_conditional finding 6 (cap binds on 20.9% of trades, x99 blow-up); CLAUDE.md Daily Risk Caps.
changes.risks: At GRM 2.25 the cap binds on more of the 2%-of-days cluster days that carry the edge; the flow-day x1.5 relief (GM-14) is the evidenced way to give those days back.
changes.intuition: The cap is the one thing standing between the book and a 2021-01-27-type short-squeeze day at full size; a growth maximiser keeps it because it is a jump-risk control, not a variance control.
changes.implementation_notes: No change except GM-14 / GM-17. Aligned sites per CLAUDE.md: order_staging constants, build_trade_ledger, daily_portfolio_report, strat_backtester defaults.

changes.name: Tiered GRM: the overflow-tier LONG strategies do not take the GRM step; ADV participation cap made tier-aware
changes.rule: For OLV, LT Trend ST OS, St OS Sznl and 52wh Breakout on the overflow universe, set OVERFLOW_RISK_OVERRIDES nominals so that effective bps at GRM 2.25 equal today's effective bps at GRM 1.5 (nominal x 1.5/2.25 = 0.667x; OLV's existing 25 -> 16.7 nominal, LT Trend 30 -> 20, St OS Sznl 40 -> 26.7, 52wh 35 -> 23.3). Overflow SHORTS (OVS, ATR Ext) take the step. Participation rule for every order: notional <= 1.0% of 21-day median dollar ADV (0.4% for strategies with ledger avgR < 0.4R: LT Trend ST OS, St OS Sznl, WCDS, IOB), hard refusal above 5%; the existing ADV participation cap is re-expressed in these terms.
changes.math: Impact in R units is volatility-invariant: cost/R ~ 0.96 x sqrt(participation) at k 0.75, k_stop 1.25; p 0.25% -> 0.05R, 1% -> 0.10R, 4% -> 0.19R, 10% -> 0.30R; impact reaches 20% of edge at p = (0.2 x edge/0.96)^2 = 0.4% (0.3R strategies) to 2.8% (0.8R). Overflow ATR Ext p90 participation 2.7% ADV already; St OS Sznl 1.6%, 52wh 1.0%. Overflow long avgR is not above liquid in any shared strategy (OLV 0.68 vs 0.97, LT 0.29 vs 0.40, St OS 0.18 vs 1.02, 52wh 0.52 vs 0.54) and carries survivorship (21 of 22 major 2020s delistings absent) plus 2x the impact (FIM small-cap 21 bps vs 11).
changes.expected_effect: Routes the entire GRM step to the liquid tier, index/ETF legs and the short book, where capacity headroom is 20-40x and survivorship is nil; leaves overflow-long P&L unchanged in dollars. Expected cost of NOT raising overflow longs: roughly the overflow-long share of the GRM gain, ~15-20% of it, against an unmeasured survivorship overstatement the haircut analyst puts at 15% (keep 0.85, range 0.80-0.92).
changes.confidence: moderate-high (direction), moderate (magnitude)
changes.evidence: estimation_haircut findings 4 and 7 (survivorship class factors, tier split); unconstrained_growth 03 (participation, edge-halving m 12-19 for the three overflow longs); broker base rates (FIM cost regression 7.4 bps per sqrt(% ADV), Avramov-Chordia-Goyal, Novy-Marx-Velikov small/micro net returns).
changes.risks: OVERFLOW_RISK_OVERRIDES currently has one carrier (OLV) and the engine applies it via overflow_active; adding three carriers is a small config change but each is an aligned-sites edit (daily_scan, daily_portfolio_report, strat_backtester). St OS Sznl's liquid cell is N = 11, so its tier split is unreliable either way.
changes.intuition: The overflow tier is the one place the ledger lies to you (survivorship) and the one place your fills can move the price; a growth maximiser puts the marginal dollar where neither is true.
changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config.OVERFLOW_RISK_OVERRIDES: {OLV: 16.7, LT Trend ST OS: 20, St OS Sznl: 26.7, 52wh Breakout: 23.3} nominal (GRM-scaled at import as today); the ADV cap lives in daily_scan's sizing step (existing ADV participation cap) with a per-strategy threshold field.

changes.name: Haircut: 40% central (27-71%) on the book mean; per-strategy keeps as the L1 shrinkage; costs into the engine; live reconciliation from broker fills
changes.rule: Replace the plan's 50% placeholder with keep_book = 0.60 (haircut 40%, range 27-71%). Use keep_s per strategy as the mu shrinkage in L1 (GM-8): 3x ETF Fade 0.78, 3x Bear 0.74, ATR Ext 0.73, MonFri 0.72, Monday Dip 0.69, IOB 0.68, Sector BO 0.65, St OS 0.50, OLV 0.45, LT Trend 0.41, WCDS 0.37, 52wh 0.31 (judgement 0.42), OVS 0.30 (judgement 0.50; held at 1.0x base because it is cap-bound). Pilots (3x Leader N 24, Monthly Weak Close N 14): mean capped at 0.5x ledger until N >= 50. Overflow longs: standing 0.85 survivorship keep. Add $0.005/share ($1 floor, both sides) and an ADV-bucketed MKT/MOC half-spread (1.5-12 bps) to process_signals_fast. Build the live-vs-ledger reconciliation from broker fills (trade_journal.py daily, harvest the DO fills ring before its 14-day retention, match on orderRef); until >= 150 matched fills exist live R = ledger R is the assumption. Re-derive the haircut at 150 fills and after 2027 Q1 (first non-midterm OOS quarters); OLV and LT Trend ST OS are the re-read triggers (their 2026 is least explained by cycle or dial).
changes.math: keep_book = 0.5 x PnL-weighted composite (0.51) + 0.5 x direct blend (0.70) = 0.605. Direct: DSR keep 0.72 at N 250 trials x cost 0.92 x survivorship 0.95 = 0.63 structural; realised-2026 keep 0.76 (mean of the risk-weighted 2026 ratio 0.52 and the midterm-conditioned ratio capped at 1.0). Costs: 0.025 R/trade = 5.6% of avgR book-wide (OVS 8.5%, WCDS 9.7%); marginal bar-touch fills a further 1.8-3.8%.
changes.expected_effect: Ledger avgR 0.453 -> ~0.428 once costs are modelled; the haircut-Kelly m* moves from 9-12 (50%) to 10.5-14 (40%); no change to GRM (margin-bound either way). Turns the growth-side numbers from in-sample to measured over the next 2-4 quarters.
changes.confidence: moderate (both estimators bracket 0.60; neither is independent of the 2026 year)
changes.evidence: estimation_haircut_results.json (per_strategy keep_central/range, book block); findings 3 (DSR keep 0.63-0.79), 4 (survivorship), 6 (costs), 5 (no broker R series exists yet).
changes.risks: The 108-trade post-rule-freeze window is uninformative (ratio 0.36, CI [-0.57, 1.22]); 2026 is one partial midterm year; the keeps feed the L1 walk-forward as static numbers derived partly from 2026 (mild lookahead, flagged in GM-8).
changes.intuition: The output of every sizing formula is an order of magnitude more sensitive to mu than to rho; a measured 40% beats a guessed 50%, and a per-strategy keep beats either.
changes.implementation_notes: scripts/build_trade_ledger.py: commission + exit-spread model in process_signals_fast (engine parity item, no live change); OneDrive trade_journal.py scheduled daily; a small scripts/live_vs_ledger.py that matches fills to ledger keys and publishes the ratio on the Execution tab.
changes.base_rate_support: McLean-Pontiff -26% OOS / -58% post-publication; Suhonen -73% median for bank alt-beta; Ilmanen -30% for robust factors; Harvey-Liu: flat 50% is 'a serious mistake', haircut should be t-dependent (which the per-strategy keeps are).

changes.name: Keep-weighted Kelly tilt on base bps, clip [0.5, 1.6], annual re-fit (replaces the plan's flat-50%-shrunk half-blend clipped [0.6, 1.4])
changes.rule: Multiplier_s = clip(w_s, 0.5, 1.6) with w = Sigma_tilde^-1 (keep_s x mu_s) on the per-strategy daily MTM series 2010+ through the prior December (Ledoit-Wolf shrunk covariance, weights normalised to mean |w| = 1). Fit through 2025: 52wh 0.50, St OS Sznl 0.50, WCDS 0.50, Sector BO 0.62, Monday Dip 0.72, IOB 0.88, LT Trend ST OS 1.07, ATR Ext 1.13, 3x Bear Fade 1.39, OLV 1.46, MonFri 1.60, 3x ETF Fade 1.60 but CAPPED at 1.25 (the margin-expensive sleeve that owns the binding 2023-02-03 day: 9.3 margin $ per risk $ under PM, 18.6 under rules). OVS held at 1.0 (cap-bound; its levers are GM-10/11/17). Pilots (3x Leader, Monthly Weak Close) at 1.0 of pilot bps, never raised on their own estimates. Composes multiplicatively with every existing overlay. A strategy below 0.5 for two consecutive years is a retirement question.
changes.math: Growth-optimal split inside a fixed total is f = Sigma^-1 mu; with estimation error the shrinkage that maximises OOS growth is the per-strategy keep (Baker-McHale form alpha = t^2/(t^2+1) generalised to the measured keep). Walk-forward 2014-2026, each weight set vol-matched in sample to equal weights: equal ann 24.2% / vol 11.8 / Sharpe 2.05 / maxDD -12.1; plan half-blend 28.0 / 13.1 / 2.14 / -11.9, 12 of 13 years better, worst year vs equal -12.5%, cumulative +50.6 pts NAV; keep-full clip[0.5,1.6] 29.3 / 13.6 / 2.16 / -14.7, 10 of 13, worst year -7.9%, cumulative +68.1; unclipped keep-full 28.2 / 13.7 / 2.06 / -13.6 with worst year -46% (2014); raw full Kelly 30.2 / 15.2 / 1.99 / -16.7 worst year -90%. Margin: keep weights use 5.3% NAV mean requirement vs 8.2% for equal weights (35% cheaper) at Sharpe 2.25 vs 2.16 in sample; a margin shadow price on top moves nothing (lambda sweep 0-4: mean margin 5.3 -> 4.9%, Sharpe 2.25 -> 2.22).
changes.expected_effect: +5.2 pts NAV/yr over the equal allocation at m 1 (ledger basis, 13-year walk-forward), +1.3 pts over the plan's half-blend, at +1.8 pts of vol and 2.6 pts more maxDD than equal; scales with GRM (~+7.8 pts/yr at GRM 2.25). Cuts the four strategies that own 61% of worst-5%-day losses for 36% of P&L (52wh, Sector BO, WCDS, IOB) and raises the diversifiers (3x fades, MonFri, OLV, LT Trend). The tilt itself lowers the book's mean margin requirement by about a third, which is what funds most of the GRM step: at GRM 2.25 x 5.3/8.2 the tilted book's mean requirement is 0.97x today's.
changes.confidence: moderate: two independent estimators (per-trade exact Kelly with concurrency, daily Sigma^-1 mu) agree on the cuts and raises; the keep factors are in-sample judgements partly informed by 2026 (mild lookahead in the walk-forward); the clip does most of the work (unclipped forms have -46% to -90% worst years)
changes.evidence: growthmax_3_alloc_keep.json (weights_2025, walk_forward summary/yearly, ship_multipliers, margin_shadow_price); baseline plan L1a-1e (per-trade f*, concurrency, tail ownership, route agreement 0.41); estimation_haircut per-strategy keeps and trust tiers; growthmax_1 margin_per_risk_by_strategy.
changes.risks: The plan's engine-confirmation gate (P3) still applies: the daily-series overlay cannot see cap interactions, and raised strategies hit their 250 cap more (MonFri and OLV at 1.46-1.60). Pass rule unchanged: process_signals_fast(risk_multipliers=...) must reproduce >= half the walk-forward gain with maxDD no worse by > 1 pt. The 3x ETF Fade cap at 1.25 is a margin decision, not an edge decision; revisit if IBKR confirms the 45% rate. The 0.5 floor on 52wh/WCDS/St OS is a 50% cut on strategies whose recent era is their best (WCDS 2022-26 avgR 0.96 on N 61): the expanding window is what survived the recency-weighted variants out of sample, and the annual re-fit lets a real improvement earn its way back at <= 60% per year.
changes.intuition: Jensen-Kelly-Pedersen: backtest RANK survives out of sample even when LEVELS do not; Wiecki: raw backtest Sharpe rank has near-zero OOS content for over-fit algos. The keep factor is the reconciliation: it lets the ordering through while shrinking the strategies with the most versions, the most era concentration and the most survivorship.
changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config: a per-strategy base-bps multiplier table (or an execution field 'l1_mult') applied to risk_bps at import after GRM; annual re-fit is mechanical (growthmax_3_alloc_keep.py with the prior year appended); numbers and NLV go in the commit message. order_staging needs nothing. Engine replay via process_signals_fast(risk_multipliers=...) is the gate.
changes.base_rate_support: Busseti-Ryu-Boyd: heterogeneous Kelly beats uniform fractional Kelly by ~34% growth at equal tail risk; Thorp Sec. 8 multi-asset f = Sigma^-1 mu; Chopra-Ziemba: errors in means matter ~10x more than in covariances, which is why the keep shrinkage is on mu only.

changes.name: OVS bottom-extremity cut with redeployment: 0.5x when mean(rank_2d, 5d, 10d, 21d) < 94, P1 base 1.25x when >= 94
changes.rule: OVS signal-time mult = 0.5 if mean of the four short-window rank filters < 94 else 1.25 (P1 and P2 alike; composes with path, cycle mult, scale-out and both caps). At the ledger mix (33% of OVS staged risk in the < 94 cell) total OVS staged risk is unchanged: 0.67 x 1.25 + 0.33 x 0.5 = 1.0. Replayed point-in-time in the engine from the same rank columns.
changes.math: Cell < 94: N 392, avgR +0.17, win 0.59; >= 94: N 878, avgR +0.47, win 0.71; mu/sigma^2 ratio 3.1x, so the Kelly split between the cells is ~3:1, and 1.25/0.5 = 2.5 is the shrunk form. Fixed rule on equal total OVS risk: R per unit risk 0.298 -> 0.337 (+12.9%), 17/24 years better, daily-P&L sd x1.06, worst year -$13.9k (2020 cluster year); symmetric (< 94 0.5x, >= 97 1.25x): +16.5%, 16/24 years, sd x1.08; walk-forward tercile form +19.7% P&L, 13/18 years. Extremity t +5.38 (217 episodes), LOYO 80%, holds in both tiers, both gap paths, all four eras, independent of the T+1 gap (t +2.60) and signal density (t +5.44).
changes.expected_effect: About +$78k over 24 years at constant OVS risk (+12.9% of $607k), roughly +$3k/yr at m 1, scaling with GRM; if the freed risk were NOT redeployed the cut alone costs -$36k/24y for a 33% smaller OVS footprint (not the growth-lens choice). Win rate and expectancy move together here (+0.12 win, +0.30R), so this is not the deleted meta-labeller's P(win) trap.
changes.confidence: moderate-high on the cell (strong grade in the signal-quality study); moderate on the redeployed form (cap interactions unreplayed)
changes.evidence: signal_quality finding 1 and recommendation 1 (rules R1-R8, threshold sweep 93-96: 17-18/24 years); growthmax lens applies Kelly's mu/sigma^2 to the two cells.
changes.risks: Cut-point 94 and 0.5x were chosen after seeing tercile tables (the walk-forward tercile form is the clean OOS check). The 1.25x on >= 94 raises P1 rows toward the 250 (375 under GM-17) cap on cluster days; engine replay with both caps is the confirmation. Midterm years flatten the gradient (bottom +0.10 vs +0.17).
changes.intuition: OVS is a reversal of a prior blow-off; the size of the blow-off is the size of the reversal, so the marginal signal that barely clears the 85 rank threshold is a different, weaker trade than one at 97.
changes.implementation_notes: daily_scan sizing step (new 2e 'signal-quality tier') reading the rank_ret_{2,5,10,21}d columns the filter already computes; strat_backtester step 3b mirror; stamp the tier in Sizing notes. Guard test on the boundary at 94. Prereg the post-ship review: >= 94 cell R/risk on the first 100 live-staged OVS fills >= 1.5x the < 94 cell, else retire.

changes.name: OVS path-2 aggregate daily cap 0.75% -> 1.5% nominal (1.125% -> 2.25% effective at GRM 1.5; scales with GRM)
changes.rule: path2_daily_cap_pct: 0.75 -> 1.5 nominal; keep the per-strategy cap (GM-17) as the tail bound.
changes.math: 202 of 609 P2 trades capped; capped avgR +0.37 vs uncapped +0.18 (capping happens on cluster days, the good days). Uncapping all P2 rows to 12 bps effective: +$49.5k / 24y = +8.1% of OVS P&L; worst single-day extra -$1.4k, best +$11.9k; positive in 11 of 14 capping years.
changes.expected_effect: About +$2k/yr at m 1 with a worst extra day of -$1.4k; the freed room goes to higher-extremity P2 rows under GM-9 (P2 low-extremity cell is +0.06R, N 201).
changes.confidence: moderate (cluster-year concentrated; engine replay needed)
changes.evidence: signal_quality finding 3.
changes.risks: Interacts with GM-17 and the 2-path scheme in order_staging (both P2 stamps and the cap are order_staging's); replay before ship.
changes.intuition: A cap whose worst extra day is -$1.4k is not doing tail work; it is only trimming the best days.
changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config OVS execution path2_daily_cap_pct (source of truth, GRM-scaled at import); order_staging reads the stamped Path2_Daily_Cap_Pct; engine mirror.

changes.name: OLV market-pullback tilt: 1.25x when SPY closes 3-10% below its 252-day high at the signal close (half of the fitted 1.5x); 1.5x after two clean quarters
changes.rule: execution['market_state_bands'] on Oversold Low Volume: SPY close / rolling-252d high - 1 in [-0.10, -0.03) -> 1.25x, else 1.0x (the at-highs side stays 1.0x: a 0.5x cut there costs -$18k risk-matched, cell still +0.56R). Composes with the recency/depth ladder, earnings override and ticker cap. Engine replays it point-in-time from master_prices. Ship rule (already met on the study series): clustered t >= 1.5 on 2010+ AND >= 10 of 15 walk-forward years; adopt 1.5x only after two live quarters with the 3-10 cell's PnL/risk >= the rest.
changes.math: OLV 3-10 cell avgR 1.184 (N 103) vs 0.554 rest, t 2.98, 8 pos / 1 neg years, survives Size_Mult >= 0.99 (t 2.4) and dial < 50 (t 3.04). Single-strategy walk-forward: PPR 0.796 -> 0.885 (+11.3%), 11/15 years, OLV Sharpe 1.33 -> 1.36, maxDD -2.75 -> -2.33. Fixed 1.5x: 16/17 years PPR better, book Sharpe 2.515 -> 2.553, maxDD -8.17 -> -8.09, +$74k risk-matched over 16y; 1.25x is the half-tilt.
changes.expected_effect: +$40-75k risk-matched over 16y (+$3-5k/yr at m 1), book Sharpe +0.02-0.04, maxDD unchanged; open OLV risk rises only in pullbacks where it is currently low (flow 19.9/yr at 3-10 vs 16.2 at < 3 but shallower stacks).
changes.confidence: moderate (11/15 WF years, 16/17 fixed-rule years, survives every subset; one of ~900 regime cells but with a mechanism and LOYO)
changes.evidence: cycle_macro finding 6 and recommendation 2; base rate: Nagel 2012 (liquidity-provision returns rise with volatility/stress), CFM 'hidden beta in dip trade' (part of this is beta: SPY fwd 10d +1.25% off-high vs +0.46% near-high).
changes.risks: Partly a beta channel; if the whole-book hedge (GM-19) ships, re-test on hedged returns before moving to 1.5x. Overflow survivorship flatters OLV's absolute avgR (relative state effect less exposed). It is PIT-clean (a price state, no fitted weights), unlike the retired dial band.
changes.intuition: OLV buys low-volume weakness in a name above its 200-SMA; when the index itself has pulled back 3-10% inside an uptrend the washout is market-wide and the recovery has a tailwind. At highs the same signal is idiosyncratic and weaker.
changes.implementation_notes: Generic 'market_state_bands' execution field (SPY state at signal close is available to the PM scan); daily_scan sizing step + strat_backtester mirror + Sizing note; guard test on the -3% / -10% boundaries.

changes.name: LT Trend ST OS plain frag band [[50, 999, 0.5]] on the point-in-time dial (the one exemption that fails PIT), composed with the solo/adds rule

Single-strategy WF 2019+: PPR +14%, 5/6 years, strategy Sharpe 1.00 -> 1.14, maxDD -2.25 -> -1.43; fixed 0.5x at PIT >= 50: book Sharpe 3.514 -> 3.525, +$47k risk-matched over 8y. On PIT the book's [65,999) cell is +0.006R (t 0.04) and OLV's +0.235R: OLV and OVS stay exempt.

changes.confidence: moderate-low (9 episodes, 5 negative; two big negative episodes carry 28 of 62 trades)
changes.evidence: cycle_macro finding 5 and recommendation 3; within_strategy_adds finding 6 (LT adds x dial cells); the plan's P2 protocol at the 50 line instead of 65.

changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config LT Trend execution frag_risk_bands (source of truth); engine 3b3 and daily_scan 2b already generic; tests/test_frag_risk_bands.py carrier list. Prereg doc: append to scratch/ultracode_research/olv_frag_band_prereg style file with the gate above.

changes.name: Flow-aware per-strategy daily cap: 250 -> 375 bps on the family's top-tercile 5d candidate-flow days (dip_buy, oversold_hold, short_fade; breakout excluded)
changes.rule: cap_bps = 375 (x1.5) on any day the family's trailing-5d raw candidate count (inclusive of today, from the same filter masks daily_scan evaluates, BEFORE earnings blackout / T+1 gates) is at or above its threshold: dip_buy >= 6, oversold_hold >= 7, short_fade >= 104; else 250. Applied in order_staging's per-strategy cap stage and the engine's cap post-pass. Never x99.
changes.math: Cap binds on 20.9% of trades (130 strategy-days); in the top f5 tercile: dip_buy 11.8% bound / mean scale 0.96, oversold_hold 25.7% / 0.88, short_fade 78.0% / 0.38. avgR on cap-bound vs unbound: OVS 0.62 vs 0.20, WCDS 0.96 vs 0.24, 3x ETF Fade 1.25 vs 0.52, OLV 1.59 vs 0.69. Unfitted relief x1.5, 2010-2026: book P&L +3.8% (+$132k), risk +2.0%, PnL/risk 0.491 -> 0.499, Sharpe 2.199 -> 2.222, maxDD and worst-21d byte-identical, 10/17 years better and 7 identical. x99 on short_fade hi-flow days: Sharpe 1.18 -> 0.93, maxDD -$44k -> -$127k.
changes.expected_effect: +3.8% book P&L with Sharpe up and identical tails at m 1 (~+$8k/yr); the cleanest flow rule in the pack because it acts on the cap, not on base bps.
changes.confidence: moderate-high (unfitted thresholds from pre-2010 data, mechanical mechanism, tails unchanged); verify live placed totals vs the ledger's implied ones first
changes.evidence: flow_conditional finding 6 and recommendation 1; within_strategy_adds finding 5 (OVS P1 depth >= 6 legs booked at 2.5-4 bps/fill on the biggest days).
changes.risks: Relief replay keeps the same fills at larger size and does not model impact of larger OVS baskets on 9+ signal days (participation is < 0.3% ADV for OVS liquid, so small). Live counts must be raw candidate masks, not staged rows, or every threshold shifts.
changes.intuition: Signal density IS the edge in this book (Spearman 0.24 with next-month vol and 0.22 with next-month mean); the cap pro-rates across staged signals, so on the best days each fill gets the smallest size.
changes.implementation_notes: daily_scan: compute family candidate counts from filters.live_signal_mask across the family's strategies (a pre-pass), stamp Cap_Bps per row; order_staging reads the stamp (PER_STRAT_DAILY_CAP_DOLLARS override per day); engine process_signals_fast cap post-pass takes a per-(strategy, date) cap. Family map: dip_buy = WCDS, IOB, Monday Dip, MonFri, St OS Sznl, Monthly Weak Close; oversold_hold = OLV, LT Trend ST OS; short_fade = OVS, ATR Ext, 3x fades; breakout = 52wh, Sector BO.

changes.name: Up-only family flow multiplier 1.25x on base bps on the same top-tercile flow days (dip_buy gated to dial < 50); never the 0.75x low-flow leg
changes.rule: New sizing step after 2b (frag band) and before 2c (recency ladder): mult = 1.25 when the family's trailing-5d candidate count >= threshold (dip_buy >= 6 AND 10d-MA 63d dial < 50; oversold_hold >= 7; short_fade >= 104), else 1.0. No breakout carrier. No down-size on low flow (the 0.75x leg costs 5.7% P&L for 9.1% less risk; at 7-15% of Kelly with margin as the binding constraint that trade is not growth-optimal). Post-ship review pre-registered: PnL/risk on the first 60 hi-flow trades >= 1.3x the concurrent lo/mid-flow trades, else retire.
changes.math: Flow terciles within family: dip_buy avgR 0.216 / 0.657 / 0.569 (PnL/risk 0.212 -> 0.572), t_ep 2.70; oversold_hold 0.317 / 0.571 / 0.855 (0.314 -> 0.835), t 3.00; short_fade 0.298 / 0.367 / 0.678 (0.331 -> 0.687), t 3.21; per-year Spearman positive 82-84% of 22 years; survives dial / VIX / trend / rv / drawdown controls; dip_buy effect absent at dial >= 30 (+0.03R), hence the gate. Up-only 1.25x, 2010-2026, cap re-applied: book P&L +5.0% at +4.2% risk, PnL/risk 0.494, Sharpe 2.197 (flat), maxDD -$92.9k -> -$102.8k, 17/17 years better, worst year +1%. Combined with GM-13: +9.9% P&L, +6.8% risk, Sharpe 2.224, maxDD -$102.8k, 17/17. Fitted WF form: +10.4%, Sharpe 2.20 -> 2.25, 15/17.
changes.expected_effect: +5.0% book P&L (~+$10k/yr at m 1) with Sharpe flat and maxDD +10.7%; with GM-13 +9.9% (~+$20k/yr). It is a growth lever, not a Sharpe lever: high-flow legs are one correlated bet, so variance rises with the extra legs.
changes.confidence: moderate (expectancy evidence strong: t 2.7-3.3, 17/17 years; Sharpe-neutral by construction; exactly the appetite decision the brief invites)
changes.evidence: flow_conditional findings 1, 2, 4, 5 and recommendation 2; seasonality_flow finding 5 (OVS same-day 5+ cell avgR 0.65 vs 0.23, q 0.002).
changes.risks: Fitted mults never left [0.74, 1.45]; 0.5x/1.5x forms are worse on Sharpe in every family, so do not widen. Composes with the OLV ladder (first-iteration OLV on a hi-flow day = 0.5 x 1.25 = 0.625x) and with GM-15 (WCDS add on a hi-flow day = 1.25 x 1.25 = 1.56x, cap-bounded). The size-DOWN 'crowded selloff' reading is wrong-signed in every reverting family and must not be added later.
changes.intuition: When many setups fire together the tape is in the state the strategies were built for; the isolated signal on a quiet day is the one most likely to be noise.
changes.implementation_notes: Shares GM-13's family candidate-count pre-pass; strategy_config execution field 'family_flow_mult' with {family, threshold, mult, dial_gate}; engine mirror in step 3b; Sizing notes stamp; guard test for the threshold boundaries and the dial gate.

changes.name: OLV recency ladder re-keyed to max(ticker-recency rung, sleeve-depth rung) with a 1.25x rung at 6+ open; no sleeve cap; keep the 50%-NAV ticker cap; same-ticker adds at full size
changes.rule: mult = max(recency_rung(ticker, 21td) in {0.5, 0.7, 1.0}, depth_rung(n_open_OLV_legs incl. working limits) in {0.5 at 0 open, 0.7 at 1-2, 1.0 at 3-5, 1.25 at 6+}); composes with the earnings override (GM-21), GM-11 and GM-14 as today. Depth counts filled legs PLUS working OLV entries (the T+3 fill window makes up to 3 days of unfilled limits invisible otherwise).
changes.math: OLV avgR by open legs at entry: solo 0.48 (N 86), 1 open 0.73 (57), 3-5 0.93 (58), 6-12 1.13 (51), 13+ 1.18 (23); adds vs solo +0.39R, episode-bootstrap P 0.017; depth >= 3 +0.57R, P 0.007. Current ladder halves 81% of solo legs but also 43-49% of legs entered into 3+ open names. Replays 2005-2026 (P&L / risk / PnL per $ risk / exit worst-21d / exit maxDD / MTM maxDD): current $418k / $529k / 0.790 / -14.0k / -20.6k / -40.6k; no ladder $643k / $845k / 0.761 / -17.1k / -27.4k / -56.1k; max(recency, depth) $543k / $662k / 0.820 / -13.4k / -19.6k / -54.1k (+$125k raw, +$16k at equal risk, 15/20 years PnL/risk >= current); depth ladder with 1.25x at 6+: $584k / $696k / 0.839 (+$26k at equal risk). Kelly-concurrency (1 + n rho) and sqrt-n budgets: 0.651 / 0.678 (lose). Same-ticker adds 0.98R (1 open 0.86, 2 open 1.06, 3+ 1.92, 7/7 wins); same-sector 2+ open 1.16R.
changes.expected_effect: OLV P&L $418k -> ~$584k over 21y (+$166k, ~+$8k/yr at m 1), PnL per $ risk 0.790 -> 0.839, exit-basis worst-21d and maxDD better, MTM maxDD wider only because the footprint grows 25% (at equal risk -43.3k vs -40.6k). The only within-strategy change that improves total P&L, P&L per unit risk AND the realised worst-21d together.
changes.confidence: moderate (clustered t 1.6-2.0, LOYO floors 1.0-1.5, bootstrap P 0.007-0.017; the ladder remains an appetite cut on the weak cell)
changes.evidence: within_strategy_adds findings 1-4 and recommendation 1; flow_conditional finding 7 (OLV open-leg count hi vs lo 0.849 vs 0.336, t 3.12, positive 94% of years); baseline plan L2 (OLV stacks are one bet with rising per-leg edge; sleeve cap rejected -$70k/16y).
changes.risks: The 2026-07-29 open-count ladder was retired for operational reasons (reset on chain exit, blind to working limits, jumped to full on leg 2); counting open + working legs fixes the first two and the graded rungs the third. Depth on filled legs only would under-count live; engine parity needs the same convention (the engine can see candidate pre-pass working limits). Implied pairwise rho 0.73-0.99 means a deep stack is ONE bet of 6-12 x 52.5 bps: the size of that bet must be visible (n_eff on the hedge panel) and the whole-book hedge (GM-19) is what removes its market part.
changes.intuition: The n-th OLV leg is entered into a sector washout that has already happened; the same-ticker second signal is a deeper washout in the same name. Kelly sizes by marginal expected R, and every depth cell says the marginal leg is the better leg.
changes.implementation_notes: strategy_config OLV execution: signal_recency_ladder unchanged + new 'depth_ladder': {window: open+working, mults: [0.5, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.25]} with 'combine': 'max'; daily_scan step 2c: load_open_position_counts (dormant machinery) + working OLV entries from the staging tab / execution tab; strat_backtester: candidate pre-pass counts open legs + unfilled candidates inside the fill window; tests/test_olv_stop_and_cap.py extended.

changes.name: OVS per-strategy daily cap 250 -> 375 bps effective (the P2 aggregate cap per GM-10); no sector or ticker clamps on OVS
changes.rule: order_staging PER_STRAT_DAILY_CAP_DOLLARS['Overbot Vol Spike'] = 375 bps x NAV; engine process_signals_fast cap_bps per strategy; build_trade_ledger aligned. Composes with GM-13 (375 x 1.5 = 562 on hi-flow days) and GM-9's 1.25x on >= 94 rows.
changes.math: OVS P1 avgR by open legs (booked bps per fill): solo 0.23 (53.8), 1-2 open 0.27 (47.0), 3-5 0.54 (32.1), 6-12 0.77 (22.9), 13+ 0.82 (4.4); largest day 2023-12-13 P1 fills at 2.5 bps each. Proxy replay (P1 depth >= 6 x1.5 ~ cap 375): OVS P&L $607k -> $699k (+15%), PnL/risk 0.298 -> 0.327, worst day -$26.1k -> -$35.3k (2021-01-27), worst-21d unchanged -$38.4k, MTM maxDD -$51.6k -> -$55.3k, active Sharpe 1.88 -> 1.84; x2: $791k, worst day -$44.4k. Depth >= 6 vs solo: clustered t 2.6 (6-12) and 4.6 (13+), LOYO floors 1.9 / 4.4, bootstrap P < 0.001, 8/10 years positive; 2+ same-sector adds 0.69R (t 4.7, 11/11 years).
changes.expected_effect: +$92k/23y (~+$4k/yr at m 1), PnL/risk +10%, worst day ~35% worse on the one short-squeeze day per decade; +$58k at equal risk. Combined with GM-13's relief on the same days the OVS cluster-day booked size rises from 2.5-4 bps/fill toward 6-9.
changes.confidence: moderate-high on the cell; moderate on the magnitude (a cap change also scales staged-but-unfilled rows)
changes.evidence: within_strategy_adds finding 5 and recommendation 2; flow_conditional finding 6 (OVS cap-bound days avgR 0.62 vs 0.20).
changes.risks: 2021-01-27 is the single-day tail the 250 cap exists for; at 375 it is -$35k at m 1 and -$53k at GRM 2.25 (-7% NAV). Must be replayed with the P2 aggregate cap and GM-9 in the engine before ship. Requires the OneDrive order_staging constant plus build_trade_ledger and the engine cap (four aligned sites).
changes.intuition: On the days when 13+ OVS signals fire, every fill is a 2.5-bps ticket on a 0.8R trade; the cap is a scalar throttle on exactly the days the strategy exists for.
changes.implementation_notes: Per CLAUDE.md Daily Risk Caps aligned sites; PER_STRAT_DAILY_CAP_DOLLARS per-strategy override already exists in order_staging (currently empty).

changes.name: WCDS and LT Trend ST OS: solo 0.75x / adds 1.25x (adds = any leg entered with >= 1 same-strategy leg open, incl. same-day clusters)
changes.rule: mult = 0.75 if n_open_{strategy} == 0 else 1.25; composes with frag/P-C bands, the L1 multiplier (GM-8) and GM-14; the 250 cap stays. Same-sector clusters explicitly NOT cut.
changes.math: WCDS: same-day adds 0.73R (N 75, t 2.7, LOYO 2.1, P 0.021) vs solo 0.21R (156); per signal day 1 fill 0.14R ($579/day) vs 4-5 fills 0.93R ($14.4k/day). changes.name: Variance-only clone controls kept from the baseline, re-thresholded: 52wh 0.5x at >= 6 open (not >= 5), IOB SPY+QQQ same-day 0.5x each, dip-buy cross-strategy same-ticker clamps extended; no correlation-, sector-, ticker- or stack-age-keyed cut anywhere else
changes.rule: 52wh Breakout: mult 0.5 if n_open_52wh >= 6 (labelled tail insurance; re-exam at +15 legs, retire if the cell's avgR >= 0.4). Indices Oversold Bounce SPY+QQQ same-day pairs 0.5x each (rho 0.88, no extra edge). CROSS_STRATEGY_OVERLAP_OVERRIDES extended to every dip-buy pair (14 pairs, R corr 0.97). Negative results: rho > 0.6 cuts lose PnL/risk in OLV 0.790 -> 0.762, OVS 0.298 -> 0.284, WCDS 0.281 -> 0.243, LT 0.301 -> 0.289; Kelly-concurrency OLV 0.651 vs 0.790.

changes.intuition: Two tickets on one horse is not diversification, so halve each; but a second leg of a different washout is a better bet, not a clone, and the correlation number says nothing about which is which.

changes.name: Dial-armed whole-book beta hedge (ES/MES): promote P1 to paper-track-then-ship at 50/45, 126d or shrunk beta, 1.0x; VIX-gated variant as a second-stage prereg; hedge-panel factor display
changes.rule: armed = hysteresis(10d-MA 63d dial lag-1 >= 50 arm, < 45 release); MES contracts = beta_hat x NAV / (50 x ES) with beta_hat = 126-session lag-1 OLS of the flat-basis book MTM on SPY (or 0.5 x 63d + 0.5 x expanding), clipped [-1, 2], refreshed daily; hedge ratio 1.0x, never above 1.5x; target = the WHOLE book (not the dip-buy family + OLV); instrument SPY/ES only (not NQ, not RTY); native MOC entry per the 2026-08-21 encoding rule; released fully below 45. Paper period: one full armed episode logged on the hedge panel. Second-stage sensitivity, decision rule fixed now: adopt 'arm only if VIX < 20, forced release at VIX >= 30' only if it is not worse than plain 50/45 across the next two out-of-sample armed episodes. Display: rolling 126d book beta with up/down split, effective N and n_active, momentum-factor loading (~15% of book variance at dial >= 50, carriers OLV/52wh/LTT/3x Fade, not covered by the SPY hedge), per-strategy SPY-covariance share while armed, OLV stack n_eff.
changes.math: Optimal index position with a costless future: w_m = mu_m/sigma_m^2 - beta' w_idio; at dial >= 50 the conditional SPY mean is negative (65-80 bucket -28.9% ann on current weights; PIT armed days -9.7%) so the term flips sign. PIT vintage 2018-01..2026-07, 50/45: 544 armed days, 13 episodes, +$104.3k (2.56 bps/armed day), 10/13 positive, clustered t 1.68, Sharpe 2.90 -> 3.04, maxDD -8.32% -> -8.13%, LOYO 7/9, episode bootstrap P(<= 0) 0.046, placebo rank 1.000, drop-best t 1.27; 126d beta +$110k, Sharpe 3.07, maxDD -7.89%; shrunk +$89k t 2.12. Live vintage 50/45: +$35k, 7/10, t 0.72, Sharpe 2.77 -> 2.84. 65/60 on PIT: t 0.99, P 0.134, lives on Feb-2020 (rejected as primary). Beta quality at dial >= 50: corr(beta_hat, realised next-21d beta) 63d 0.02, 42d -0.04, 126d 0.20. Realised armed beta 0.40 with up-day 0.50 / down-day 0.27: the hedge earns from drift, removes only ~6% of armed-day sd.
changes.expected_effect: ~1.3 episodes/yr, ~+$8k per episode, +0.1 to +0.15 full-sample Sharpe, maxDD 0.2-0.4 pt better, calm carry limited to false alarms (~4 in 10 episodes, ~-$5k/yr); ~+$10k/yr at m 1, scaling with GRM. Under this lens its main value is that it is the ONE dial control that removes the negative-drift factor bet without shrinking the idiosyncratic Kelly book; it keeps the book's high-dial convexity (beta_up 0.79 vs beta_down 0.26 at 65+) that a cut would destroy.
changes.confidence: moderate (passes the pre-registered ship rule on PIT with margin: t 1.68 vs 1.0, bootstrap 0.046, placebo 1.000; 13 episodes; drift-driven; 2018 PIT year is a one-signal vintage)
changes.evidence: cross_strategy_regime findings 1-6, 8 and recommendations 1-6; baseline plan L3 and P1; negative controls (VIX-armed -$158.5k 0/15 episodes t -3.85; VIX pctile -$154k; SPY dd -$139k; always-hedged -$478k).
changes.risks: Futures margin is additive on top of the equity legs (a hedge does NOT relax the GM-1 boundary). The dial was calibrated on SPY forward returns; PIT cures weight lookahead only. Daniel-Moskowitz: ex-ante beta hedges of state-dependent-beta strategies under-hedge the loss side and sell the rebound; the 126d/shrunk beta and the 1.0x cap are the mitigations, and the VIX release is the pre-registered fix for the post-spike phase where the book's beta collapses. Do not describe or justify it as variance reduction.
changes.intuition: The dial does not know when edge dies; it knows when the book's beta is highest and SPY's drift is worst (complacent, near-the-highs tape). Hedge the thing it predicts.
changes.implementation_notes: Hedge panel (site/assets/execution.js) already computes MES target arithmetic display-only; the arm/release state machine, beta series and episode log are a small scripts/build_hedge_state.py reading rd2_fragility.parquet + strategy_daily/ledger MTM; the order is placed by hand during the paper period, then by a pitch_moo-style runner with native MOC. Prereg doc = the plan's P1 with the amendments above.

changes.name: After the hedge is live: re-open the FAMILY4 / 3x Bear / Monthly Weak Close 0.25x-and-zero band at dial >= 50 as a prereg question on HEDGED returns; no change now
changes.rule: Decision rule to be written before the run: on beta-hedged trade returns, PIT dial, episode clustering, the fear-OFF zeroing is relaxed to 0.5x (and the fear-ON 1.25x boost kept) only if the family's hedged hi-dial cell avgR >= +0.30 with clustered t >= 1.0 and LOYO not negative in more than 3 of 9 years. Otherwise the band stands. Leg-C shadow tracking (pc_fear_enabled=False shadow ledger) continues to accrue the evidence.
changes.math: PIT FAMILY4: hi -0.10R vs lo +0.63R, clustered t -1.96 (p 0.057), negative 6/9 years (the cut's evidence). Book at 65+: beta_up 0.785 vs beta_down 0.261 (a cut removes that convexity; a hedge keeps it). Outside base rate: Nagel 2012, reversal expected return and conditional Sharpe rise ~0.13 per VIX point; industry reversal profitable only in high VIX. Reconciliation: P(dial >= 50 | VIX 30+) = 3.9% (PIT 3.2%): the dial's high zone is a calm-at-highs state, not the high-VIX state Nagel describes, so the two can both be true; the P/C-fear-ON branch (full/1.25x size in washouts) is already the Nagel-aligned form.
changes.expected_effect: Unknown until run; flagged because the cut and the hedge act on the same state and the cut's evidence is one notch stronger than the hedge's.
changes.confidence: low (prereg only)
changes.evidence: cross_strategy_regime recommendation 7; cycle_macro finding 4 (dial orthogonal to vol regimes); outside vol-regime pack (Nagel, Daniel-Moskowitz, Longin-Solnik).
changes.risks: The 2026-08-05 bands shipped ahead of their prereg gates as an appetite decision; this re-opens them only with the hedge in place and only on hedged returns.
changes.intuition: Half of what fails at high dial is the factor; once the factor is hedged, the residual dip-buy is the liquidity-provision trade that outside evidence says pays more in stress.
changes.implementation_notes: Study only: scratch prereg doc beside family_pc_fear_band_prereg_2026-08-05.md; engine rerun with frag bands off plus the hedge series to build the hedged-return ledger.

changes.name: OLV pre-earnings size override: restore base size in -10..0 TD (no expectancy or tail deficit in that cell); log the POST-print cut as a re-exam trigger; extend gap_size_derate to WCDS

changes.rule: OVS_same_day_count >= 5 -> risk mult 1.25 (candidate).
